Why is the SwMI not required to broadcast information about channels that fully cover the cell area?

The SwMI does not need to broadcast this information because the MS does not normally need to monitor or assess these channels, nor does it need to inform the SwMI that these channels would be usable as an assigned channel.
Under what circumstance might the SwMI choose to broadcast information about channels that fully cover the cell area?
The SwMI may choose to broadcast this information in cases where it may aid MSs that are sending or receiving real-time class data.
Why is changing to a new cell when the current channel fails not necessarily appropriate for an MS using a non-conforming PDCH?

It is not necessarily appropriate because the non-conforming PDCH may not fully cover the area covered by the main carrier, such as in the case of a high RF-bandwidth concentric channel or a sectored or semi-super-sectored channel.
What are two reasons the assigned channel replacement procedure may be used for a failing non-conforming channel?
The procedure may be used if the RF bandwidth is too high or if a sector change is needed in the case of a cell using sectored channels.
What is the definition of "assessment" in the context of MAC layer operations?

Assessment is the process of estimating the radio path loss on the serving cell main carrier or for a channel class (on the serving cell or an adjacent cell), based on measurements made on another channel or carrier radiated from the same site.
How does the MS MAC utilize signal strength measurements?

The MS MAC makes signal strength measurements autonomously on the current channel(s) on the serving cell and, under MLE control, on selected neighbouring cells and other carriers. These measurements are passed to the MLE as an approximation of the radio path loss.
Under what specific condition does the MS MAC autonomously assess the path loss on the main carrier of the serving cell?

The MS MAC performs this assessment if the MS is not currently receiving a conforming channel, and the current channel is a non-conforming concentric or sectored channel. The assessment is based on measurements made on the current channel.
What additional procedures can the MS MAC perform when requested by the MS MLE regarding path loss?

The MLE may request assessment of the path loss for selected channel classes on the serving cell. This assessment is based on the characteristics of those channel classes and the measurements made on the current channel.
What are the relevant characteristics of channel classes?
The relevant characteristics are the modulation mode, maximum permitted MS transmit power, minimum receive access level, and BS transmit power relative to the main carrier.
How does the MS calculate path loss during irregular channel monitoring?
The MS measures the signal strength of the monitored carrier and calculates the path loss using the parameters broadcast on the serving cell.
Under what condition is neighbour cell monitoring used?

Neighbour cell monitoring is used when the MS is not synchronized to the adjacent cell and has not decoded the adjacent cell's BSCH and BNCH (for a CA adjacent cell) or BSCH-Q (for a DA adjacent cell).
When is scanning of the main carrier on adjacent cells used?
Scanning is used when the MS is able to synchronize to the adjacent cell and decode the adjacent cell's BSCH and BNCH for a CA adjacent cell, or the adjacent cell's BSCH-Q for a DA adjacent cell.
How does the MS calculate path loss during scanning?
The MS measures the signal strength of the scanned carrier and calculates the path loss using the adjacent cell parameters broadcast on that adjacent cell.
On which type of channels does circuit mode traffic transmission apply in TETRA?
Circuit mode traffic transmission applies only on π/4-DQPSK channels.
Under what conditions does main carrier monitoring by the MLE particularly apply?

It applies particularly if the MS is receiving only super-sectored and/or eccentric channels (and/or channels for which it does not understand the conforming channel status), but may apply also if the MS is receiving only sectored channel(s).
What is the key difference in traffic channel allocation between message trunking and transmission trunking?
In message trunking, a traffic channel is allocated for the complete call. In transmission trunking, a traffic channel is allocated only for the duration of a traffic transmission.
How does quasi-transmission trunking manage channel de-allocation to handle quick subsequent transmissions?

In quasi-transmission trunking, the channel de-allocation is delayed for a short period at the end of each traffic transmission, so the traffic channel is retained if the next transmission in the call is requested quickly.
Which components within the TETRA stack perform most of the procedures for circuit mode calls?
Most of the procedures for circuit mode calls are performed by the CMCE and the MAC.
What procedures does the Mobility Management (MM) entity perform regarding an MS?

The MM entity performs procedures for registration and de-registration of an MS. It also performs procedures for the MS to request energy saving mode or direct mode dual watch operation, and for the MS to inform the SwMI when it is moving to direct mode and returning to trunking mode.
Under what conditions may the MM entity in the MS send a registration message to the SwMI?

The MM entity in the MS may send a registration message to the SwMI on the request of the user application, when commanded by the SwMI, or when the MS decides that registration is required (for example, if the MS has performed cell reselection into a location area outside the current registered area and the new cell requires registration).
How are support for QAM and D8PSK channels indicated during MS registration?
Support of QAM (and the QAM RF bandwidths) is declared using the "extended capabilities" information element, whereas support of D8PSK channels is indicated in the "class of MS" information element.
What is the primary function of the group identity attachment/detachment procedure?

It enables the MM entity in the MS and the SwMI to exchange information about the currently attached group identities in the MS, which are the addresses that the MAC in the MS regards as valid group addresses when checking if downlink PDUs are addressed to itself.
When can an MS attach or detach group identities?
The MS may attach or detach group identities when it performs registration, or it may do so later using a specific attach/detach message.
Which entities can initiate the group attachment/detachment procedure?
Either the MS or the SwMI can initiate the group attachment/detachment procedure. The SwMI may initiate it to change the group identities in the MS.
How did the introduction of high speed data facilities and Direct Access affect registration and group attachment/detachment methods?
The methods have not changed, except for the addition of some information in the "class of MS" information element and the introduction of the "extended capabilities" information element.
What Layer 3 capabilities may an MS indicate to the SwMI during registration?
The MS may indicate the ability to support voice calls, circuit mode data calls, concurrent circuit mode services and/or TETRA packet data.
What are the Upper MAC capabilities that an MS may indicate to the SwMI?
The MS may indicate the ability to support common secondary control channels, minimum mode for CA, carrier specific signalling channels and/or MAC-D-BLCK PDU and augmented channel allocation.
For a CA MS, what optional capabilities regarding channel operation may be indicated?
A CA MS may indicate the capability to support multi-slot channels and/or concurrent multi-carrier operation.
What are the mandatory channel and carrier operation capabilities for a DA MS?
A DA MS is required to support single-slot and multislot QAM channels, as well as single-carrier operation.
What defines the transmission and reception behavior of a frequency half duplex MS, and what is the constraint on switching time in TETRA?

A frequency half duplex MS can either transmit on an uplink frequency or receive on a downlink frequency at any time, but cannot do both simultaneously. In TETRA, the time required to switch between transmit and receive frequencies must be less than a timeslot duration.
What restriction applies to the BS when a frequency half duplex MS is operating with a multi-slot channel?

The BS should not send signalling messages to that MS when the MS is transmitting traffic or transmitting in reserved slots, or when the MS is switching from receive to transmit or from transmit to receive.
How is a fast switching MS defined in the context of frequency half duplex operation?
A fast switching MS is defined as a frequency half duplex MS capable of switching from transmit to receive, and from receive to transmit, between contiguous slots.
How is fast switching capability indicated for different channel types?
Fast switching capability on a QAM channel is indicated to the SwMI independently from fast switching capability on a π/4-DQPSK or D8PSK channel.
What is the transmission and reception capability of a frequency full duplex MS?
A frequency full duplex MS has the ability to transmit on an uplink frequency and receive on a downlink frequency at the same time.
How many uplink and downlink slots can a frequency full duplex MS use in a TDMA frame?
This type of MS can use all four uplink slots and all four downlink slots in a TDMA frame.
Which organizations and simulation techniques were used for the TETRA HSD compatibility simulations?
The simulations were carried out by WGSE (Project Teams SE7 and SE27) using the TETRA TEDS SRDoc and simulation techniques SEAMCAT and MCL.
In which frequency bands is TETRA implemented outside the EEC?
TETRA is implemented outside the EEC in frequency bands between 300 MHz and 470 MHz, and also in the 700 MHz and 800 MHz bands.
What condition is essential for the proper operation of a TETRA network regarding other networks?

The proper operation depends on meeting non-interference (compatibility) criteria with other networks, which may be TETRA or non-TETRA networks operating in the vicinity and using the same or adjacent frequency bands.
What are the components of conducted unwanted emissions in a typical transmitter?

Conducted unwanted emissions consist of close to carrier emissions (occurring in useful or transient parts of a burst), far from carrier emissions (occurring at offsets equal to or greater than 100 kHz from the carrier frequency, comprising discrete spurious emissions and wide-band noise), and emissions during linearization time periods, bursts, or the non-transmit state.
Which clause of ETSI EN 300 392-2 provides details on emission limits and their relationship with the time mask for TETRA station transmission?
Clause 6 of ETSI EN 300 392-2 [i.2] provides the details of emissions, their relationship with the time mask defined for a TETRA station transmission, and the permissible emission limits.
What specific specifications are covered in clauses 8.2.2 and 8.2.3 regarding TETRA transmitter emissions?

Clauses 8.2.2 and 8.2.3 provide detailed specifications for the modulation vector error, adjacent power level, and wide-band noise. Clause 8.2.2 covers phase modulation channels, while clause 8.2.3 covers QAM channels.
Why were MS power classes 5 and 5L added to the TETRA standard, and to which channel type do they apply?

MS power classes 5 and 5L apply only to QAM channels. They were added to allow for a higher peak-to-mean power ratio in a QAM transmitter, which results in lower mean powers compared to a phase modulation transmitter of equal rated power.
Where can measurement methods and conformance details for TETRA be found?
Measurement methods and conformance details are given in the TETRA RF conformance standard [i.3].
What is the nominal power in dBm for a Mobile Station (MS) with Power class 2?
The nominal power for an MS with Power class 2 (10 W) is 40 dBm.
Which power classes apply exclusively to QAM channels according to the note?
Power classes 5 and 5L apply only to QAM channels.
What are the values of $t_{1}$, $t_{2}$, and $t_{3}$ for Phase modulation with CB burst type under normal range operation?
For Phase modulation with CB burst type, $t_{1}$ is 16, $t_{2}$ is 103, and $t_{3}$ is 15.
Under what condition does the transmit level versus time mask apply to consecutively transmitted bursts by the same TETRA mobile station?

The transmit level versus time mask applies at the beginning of the transmission of the first burst and at the end of the transmission of the last burst whenever bursts are consecutively transmitted by the same TETRA mobile station on the same frequency.
When does the time interval $t_{1}$ start and end?
The time $t_{1}$ starts at the beginning of the ramp-up of the first burst and expires just before the symbol time of $S N 0$ for phase modulation (or $S N-Q I$ for QAM).
What are the start and end points of the time interval $t_{2}$?
The time $t_{2}$ starts at the symbol time of $S N 0$ ($S N-Q I$ for QAM) of the first burst and finishes at the symbol time of $S N \max$ ($S N-Q \max$ for QAM) of the last burst.
For phase modulation channels above 700 MHz at a 50 kHz frequency offset, what is the maximum adjacent power level for all power classes?
The maximum adjacent power level is -65 dBc.
For frequencies below 700 MHz, what is the maximum wideband noise level for MS nominal power level ≥ 5.6 W (class 2L) at a frequency offset between 250 kHz and 500 kHz?
The maximum wideband noise level is -85 dBc.
What factors contribute to out-of-band spectral emission in adjacent channels in QAM transmitter design?

Out-of-band spectral emission can be ascribed to inaccuracies in transmitter implementation, such as the non-ideality of the transmit filter (e.g., from truncation of its response) and nonlinear distortion in the final power amplifier and quadrature frequency converters.
Under what conditions should the power level at the output of the SRRC filter be measured?
The power level at the output of the SRRC filter must be measured during the transmission of the useful part of the burst, while avoiding the ramp-up and ramp-down segments.
What are the maximum admissible adjacent power levels for a 25 kHz channel bandwidth at frequency offsets of 25 kHz, 50 kHz, and 75 kHz?
For a 25 kHz channel bandwidth, the maximum admissible adjacent power levels are -55 dBc at a 25 kHz offset, -65 dBc at a 50 kHz offset, and -67 dBc at a 75 kHz offset.
At what distance from the carrier frequency do standard limits for wideband noise radiation begin, and how is this noise level measured?
Standard limits for wideband noise radiation start 100 kHz from the carrier frequency. The noise level is measured using a set-up similar to that employed for out-of-band spectral emission.
What is the maximum wideband noise level for a Mobile Station (MS) with nominal power level ≤ 3 W operating on a 25 kHz channel at a frequency offset of 100 kHz to 250 kHz?
-70 dBc
What techniques does a TETRA receiver incorporate to operate satisfactorily under multipath conditions?
Channel estimation, synchronization, and error control techniques.
What does receiver blocking performance measure?
It measures the receiver's capability to block unwanted un-modulated signals on frequencies other than spurious responses or adjacent channels.
For QAM channels, which channel bandwidths are separately covered by the TETRA standard specifications for effects 1 to 3?
25 kHz, 50 kHz, 100 kHz, and 150 kHz.
Which clauses cover the performance specifications for phase modulation and QAM channels respectively?
Phase modulation channel performance specifications are outlined in clause 8.3.2, while QAM channel performance specifications are covered in clause 8.3.3.
What are the assumed receiver noise figures for the uplink and downlink in phase modulation specifications?
The assumed receiver noise figure is 8 dB for the uplink (BS receiver) and 11 dB for the downlink (MS receiver).
What behavior is required of a receiver driven by signal plus noise under the specified static channel conditions?
The receiver is required to exhibit a BER not exceeding the indicated value.
Which propagation conditions are assumed when specifying reference performance benchmarks limited by adjacent-channel or co-channel interference?
The assumed propagation conditions are TU50, HT200 and EQ200.
Which TETRA equipment class is optimized for use in built-up and urban areas but not specified for extreme propagation conditions like hilly terrain?

Class B equipment is optimized for use in built-up and urban areas. It provides good performance at reference sensitivity and interference levels in static and TU50 conditions, but it is not specified for extreme propagation conditions such as hilly terrain.
What are the key characteristics and applicable conditions for Class D TETRA equipment?

Class D equipment has the same performance requirements as Class A for π/4-DQPSK modulation. It is further optimized to enhance the performance of π/8-D8PSK modulation in hilly or mountainous terrain using equalization or other techniques. It is resilient to extreme propagation conditions (hilly terrain) and is specified in static, TU50, and HT200 conditions.
Under which conditions is Class E TETRA equipment specified, and what are its limitations regarding BS equipment and modulation types?

Class E equipment comprises an equalizer and is specified in static, TU50, HT200 (PACQ only), and EQ200 conditions. It is not applicable to BS equipment and is only specified for π/4-DQPSK modulation.
What are the minimum required dynamic reference sensitivity levels for MS and BS equipment using π/4-DQPSK and π/8-D8PSK modulations?

The minimum required dynamic reference sensitivity levels are: - For MS with π/4-DQPSK modulation: -103 dBm - For MS with π/8-D8PSK modulation: -97 dBm - For BS with π/4-DQPSK modulation: -106 dBm - For BS with π/8-D8PSK modulation: -100 dBm
Which tables specify the maximum permissible BS receiver MER or BER at dynamic receiver sensitivity performance with phase modulation?
Tables 8.8 and 8.8a specify the maximum permissible BS receiver MER or BER at dynamic receiver sensitivity performance with phase modulation.
What is the status of performance with π/8-D8PSK modulation below 300 MHz regarding the TETRA standard?
The performance with π/8-D8PSK modulation below 300 MHz is outside the scope of the TETRA standard.
What is the static reference sensitivity level for an MS using π/4-DQPSK modulation?
-112 dBm
What is the static reference sensitivity level for a BS using π/8-D8PSK modulation?
-110 dBm
For an MS receiver using π/4-DQPSK in discontinuous downlink mode, what is the maximum permissible MER for the SCH/F logical channel?
What are the maximum permissible MER values for the AACH logical channel for an MS receiver in both continuous and discontinuous downlink modes?
28 % for both continuous and discontinuous downlink modes.
Which modulation type and frequency range are explicitly stated to be outside the scope of the TETRA standard?
The performance with π/8-D8PSK modulation below 300 MHz is outside the scope of the TETRA standard.
What is the maximum permissible BER for TCH/4,8 N = 8 under HT200 class A propagation conditions with π/4-DQPSK modulation for frequencies below 300 MHz?
What are the assumed receiver noise figures for the uplink and downlink in TETRA HSD reference performance benchmarks?
The assumed receiver noise figure is 8 dB for the uplink (BS receiver) and 11 dB for the downlink (MS receiver).
Under what propagation conditions and carrier frequency ranges are dynamic reference values defined for QAM logical channels in the presence of AWGN?
The assumed propagation conditions are TU50 and HT200, with carrier frequencies below or above 700 MHz.
Which clause specifies reference performance benchmarks when performance is limited by adjacent-channel or co-channel interference?
Clause 8.3.3.3 specifies the reference performance benchmarks to be met when the performance is limited by adjacent-channel or co-channel interference.
What is the scope of the TETRA standard regarding QAM performance below 300 MHz?
The performance with QAM below 300 MHz is outside the scope of the TETRA standard.
What is the maximum permissible receiver MER for a Base Station (BS) using 64-QAM modulation with a code rate of r=2/3 and a channel bandwidth of 50 kHz?
-94 dBm
For a Mobile Station (MS) using 4-QAM modulation with a code rate of 1/2, what is the payload percentage for the AACH-Q channel type under TU50 conditions with a 100 kHz channel bandwidth?
What is the maximum permissible receiver MER for a Mobile Station (MS) using 16-QAM modulation with a code rate of r=1/2 and a channel bandwidth of 150 kHz?
-96 dBm
For a QAM channel bandwidth of 150 kHz, what is the TETRA π/4-DQPSK interferer offset from f0?
87.5 kHz
What is the TETRA π/4-DQPSK interferer level for an MS when the QAM channel bandwidth is 25 kHz?
-63 dBm
For which logical channels is the co-channel interference ratio defined for uplink and downlink receivers respectively?
For the uplink (BS receiver), the co-channel interference ratio is defined for the SCH-Q/U logical channel only. For the downlink (MS receiver), it is defined for the SCH-Q/D logical channel only.
What are the assumed receiver noise figure (NF) values for BS uplink and MS downlink?
The assumed receiver noise figure is 8 dB for BS (uplink) and 11 dB for MS (downlink).
What is the number of symbols on each subcarrier (Ns) for NDB, FCB, NUB, CB, and RAB?
Ns is 34 for NDB and FCB, 31 for NUB, and 14 for CB and RAB.
Why has the equalizer class receiver not been maintained for high-speed channels?
The adoption of sub-carriers in these channels makes the use of equalizers unnecessary.
At what speed does a Mobile Station (MS) incur performance degradation in high velocity TETRA HSD scenarios, and what are examples of such scenarios?
Performance degradation may occur when the MS speed exceeds 200 km/h. Examples include high-velocity trains or airborne terminals such as public safety helicopters or aircraft.
Why does fading bandwidth growth at high speeds lead to performance degradation in TETRA HSD?
As speed grows, the fading bandwidth gets larger, causing the pilot symbol spacing along the time axis to become insufficient to ensure accurate sampling of the fading process.
How does the channel estimator's design contribute to performance degradation when actual speed exceeds 200 km/h?
The channel estimator is assumed to be matched to a fixed reference speed of 200 km/h. Consequently, its accuracy worsens as the actual speed continues to rise above this reference limit.
What approach is used for channel estimation and what is assumed about synchronization?
Channel estimation is based on the Bayesian-in-time linear-interpolation-in-frequency approach, and timing and frequency synchronization is assumed to be error-free.
What is the bandwidth and subcarrier configuration used for the results in Figures 8.8 and 8.9, and how does it differ from the previous figures?
The bandwidth is 150 kHz with 48 subcarriers, replacing the previous configuration of 50 kHz with 16 subcarriers.
Which factors affecting channel estimator performance are clarified by the unrealistic conditions presented in Appendix C?
The factors include fading decorrelation properties, pilot symbol spacing, and uncertainty in knowledge of MS speed.
What is the approximate roundtrip Doppler shift for a mobile station moving at 300 km/h with an 800 MHz carrier frequency?
The roundtrip Doppler shift is around 440 Hz.
How is TETRA HSD receiver performance quantified in the simulation results presented in Clause 9?
The receiver performance is given in terms of curves of Message Error Rate (MER) as a function of the signal-to-noise ratio (Eb/N0) or Signal-to-Interference Ratio (SIR).
Which logical channels are used as samples for evaluating PCCC decoder performance in Clause 9.2?
The sample logical channels include two carried by a burst payload (SCH-Q/HU and SCH-Q/D) and a few header-borne logical channels (SICH-Q/U in CB, SICH-Q/D, and AACH-Q).
What specific topic regarding unencoded channels is addressed in Clause 9.3?
Clause 9.3 parallels Clause 9.2 but focuses on the unencoded SCH-Q/HU and SCH-Q/D channels under noise and interference limited conditions.
What modulation and coding rate are used by logical channels that rely on burst headers, such as SICH-Q/U, SICH-Q/D, and AACH-Q/D?
These channels utilize 4-QAM modulation with a fixed coding rate of r = 5/16.
Where are the symbols for logical channels relying on burst headers placed within the channel bandwidth?
The corresponding symbols are placed on subcarriers within the central 25 kHz on the frequency axis of the channel bandwidth.
What are the specific signal bandwidth constraints for SCH-Q/RA, BSCH-Q, and SCH-Q/B?

SCH-Q/RA uses the 25 kHz bandwidth only. BSCH-Q uses the subcarriers within the central 25 kHz on the frequency axis. SCH-Q/B uses the outer subcarriers, which are the subcarriers not within the central 25 kHz.
Why are turbo-like codes not applied to the header information bits in SICH-Q/D, AACH-Q, and SICH-Q/U logical channels, and what alternative is used to improve decoding performance?

Turbo-like codes are precluded due to the limited number of header information bits included in these logical channels. Instead, a powerful Reed-Muller block code is used, which enables better header decoding performance compared to the payload decoder for all signal and burst formats and propagation scenarios.
Which figure shows MER vs. Eb/N0 for B=150 kHz on a static channel with SCH-Q/HU?
Figure 9.40 shows MER vs. Eb/N0 for B=150 kHz, SCH-Q/HU, static channel.
Which propagation scenarios are considered in the interference performance analysis where AWGN is replaced by co-channel interference?
The propagation scenarios considered are TU50-400 MHz, HT200-800 MHz, and static.
How does the receiver performance change across the different propagation channels in the presence of co-channel interference?
Performance improves when passing from the TU50-400 MHz channel to the HT200-800 MHz channel, and further improves from the HT200-800 MHz channel to the static channel.
What are the main assumptions regarding signal bandwidth in the simulation set-up for uncoded channel performance?
The main assumptions for signal bandwidth are $B=25 \mathrm{kH}_\mathrm{z}$, $50 \mathrm{kH}_\mathrm{z}$, $100 \mathrm{kH}_\mathrm{z}$, and $150 \mathrm{kH}_\mathrm{z}$.
Which modulation and coding rate combinations are assumed in the simulation set-up for uncoded channel performance?
The assumed modulation and coding rate combinations are 16-QAM with $r=1$ and 64-QAM with $r=1$.
How does uncoded performance in terms of MER change as the number of subcarriers or burst length grows, and why?

Uncoded performance in terms of MER gets poorer as the number of subcarriers and/or the burst length grow. This is because the Bit Error Rate (BER) is substantially independent of the data block size, making it easier to find a bit in error in a larger data block.
Under what channel and bandwidth conditions can a 10% MER often be attained?
A 10% MER can often be attained for slow fading (TU50-400 MHz) and small bandwidths (25 kHz and 50 kHz), provided that the $E_b / N_0$ ratio is adequate.
How does uncoded performance behave over fast-fading channels or with larger bandwidths?

Over fast-fading channels (notably HT200-400 MHz and HT200-800 MHz) and/or for larger bandwidths, the uncoded performance is severely degraded and the MER curves tend to exhibit a floor higher than 10%, especially for high-order modulations.
How does uncoded transmission compare to coded transmission in a static channel regarding MER and throughput?

In a static channel, uncoded transmission is poorer than coded transmission, although it permits achieving very low values of MER. However, because of the absence of coding bits, the uncoded channel has a higher throughput than the equivalent channel.
What are the channel types and bandwidth specified for Figure 9.62?
The channel types are HT200-400 MHz and HT200-800 MHz, and the bandwidth is B = 25 kHz.
Which figure shows MER vs. $E_b/N_0$ for a static channel with a bandwidth of 100 kHz?
Figure 9.68 shows MER vs. $E_b/N_0$ for a static channel with a bandwidth of 100 kHz.
What are the BS transmit mean power and BS EIRP values for both 400 MHz and 800 MHz in the downlink link budget?
The BS transmit mean power is 44 dBm and the BS EIRP is 50 dBm for both 400 MHz and 800 MHz.
What are the BS dynamic reference sensitivity values for the uplink at 400 MHz and 800 MHz?
The BS dynamic reference sensitivity is -102 dBm at 400 MHz and -103 dBm at 800 MHz.
How can a balanced TETRA link be obtained for 400 MHz or 800 MHz operations by adjusting BS transmit power?
A balanced link may be obtained by reducing the BS transmit power by 8,6 dB, which can be achieved by using a Class 6 BS transmitter (4 W) instead of the Class 2 (25 W).
What transmitter class and power levels are required for a vehicular mounted MS to achieve a balanced link with a longer range compared to a handheld MS?
The vehicular MS has to use a Class 2L or 2 transmitter with 5,6 W or 10 W power, instead of the 1 W used by the handheld MS.
Besides dual antenna space diversity, what other diversity methods may result in further balancing of uplink and downlink with increased range?
Higher levels of BS receiver diversity and/or a combination of space and polarization diversity may result in further balancing.
Why might a handheld MS using a common power amplifier for π/4-DQPSK and QAM channels fail to achieve the same mean transmit power?
It might not be possible because the two channels exhibit different Peak-to-Mean Power Ratios (PMPRs).
What are the transmit mean power levels used for all high-speed channels in the downlink and uplink?
All channels use a transmit mean power of 44 dBm in the downlink and 30 dBm in the uplink.
What is the basis for comparing range across different high-speed channels?

The basis for comparison is having identical link parameters except for receiver sensitivity, which is dictated by individual channels. Consequently, channel EIRPs on the downlink or uplink are identical for all high-speed channels.
Why is handheld terminal coverage generally uplink-limited?
Handheld terminal coverage is generally uplink-limited chiefly because of the BS EIRP advantage.
How can balanced coverage be achieved for handheld terminals?
Balanced coverage requires reducing the BS transmit power to achieve the same range as in the uplink.
Under what condition is the uplink limitation eliminated?
The uplink limitation is eliminated if vehicular mobile terminals are used as a basis for determining the uplink coverage.
What transmit mean power is assumed for handheld terminals using π/4-DQPSK and high-speed channels?
It is assumed that the handheld terminal has a transmit mean power of 1 W for π/4-DQPSK and high-speed channels.
What is the approximate increase in range when comparing urban and suburban environments for TETRA HSD channels?
Approximately an increase of 50 % in a suburban environment.
What are the transmit mean power levels used in the downlink and uplink for all TETRA HSD channels?
44 dBm in the downlink and 30 dBm in the uplink.
What is the performance of uncoded QAM channels under HT200 and TU50 multipath conditions?
No QAM channel option performs adequately under HT200 conditions. Under TU50 conditions, only a few 25 kHz and 50 kHz channels are usable.
Under which propagation conditions do uncoded channels perform more satisfactorily compared to Rayleigh conditions?
Uncoded channels perform more satisfactorily when link conditions change to Ricean (with a strong direct signal) or under line-of-sight (Gaussian) conditions.
How does the range of an uncoded 16-QAM channel with 25 kHz bandwidth compare to that of an equivalent coded channel under static conditions?
The range of the uncoded channel is about 2/3 of the equivalent coded channel.
What is the throughput relationship between uncoded and coded channels in Table 10.10, and what causes this difference?
The throughput of the uncoded channel is twice that of the coded channel in all cases, due to the 1/2 rate coding employed in coded channels.
Under what conditions is there a viable throughput versus range trade-off for using uncoded channels?
There is a viable throughput versus range trade-off for the use of uncoded channels under static or quasi-static conditions.
Which channel configuration provides the highest throughput among the group of six channels, and how does it compare to the reference channel?
The 64-QAM (r = 1/2), 50 kHz channel provides the highest throughput, which is 5 times that provided by the reference channel.
Which modulation type and coding rate combination serves as the reference channel in the throughput estimation for TETRA HSD channels?
The reference channel uses π/4-DQPSK modulation with a coding rate of r = 2/3.
How does the link budget gain advantage change for 16-QAM modulation with a coding rate of r = 1/2 when the channel bandwidth increases from 25 kHz to 150 kHz?
The link budget gain advantage changes from 0 dB at 25 kHz to -7 dB at 150 kHz.
What specific PDUs are used for the uplink and downlink in the throughput assessment for TETRA HSD channels?
The assessment uses MAC-U-BLCK PDU for the uplink and MAC-D-BLCK PDU, without slot granting element, for the downlink in an original advanced link.
Why does spectrum efficiency increase as higher channel bandwidths are used?
The reason is the longer payload field for wider channels resulting in a lower ratio of protocol header to payload bits.
What conflicting requirements do antenna designers face in cellular base stations such as TETRA?
Antenna designers face conflicting requirements of azimuthal coverage, high gain, and low interference to neighbouring cells.
How does the sectored antenna solution address range shortfalls in TETRA HSD channels?
The cell is divided into a number of equal sectors, each radiating with a directional antenna with a correct beam-width.
What trade-off is associated with extending the range of sectored channels?
Sectored channels extend their range at the expense of azimuthal coverage, requiring multiple antennas at a BS site for equivalent omni-directional coverage.
According to Table 10.15, are new BS sites necessary for high-speed channels to match the reference CA channel coverage?
No, no new BS sites are necessary for the high-speed channels.
What is the primary disadvantage of using sectored channels in TETRA networks?
The disadvantage is a more expensive base station due to duplication of hardware and the need for assigned channel replacement in moving from one sector to another within the cell.
Which modulation type and coding rate combination serves as the reference channel with an Omni antenna at 25 kHz bandwidth?
The combination is π/4-DQPSK with a coding rate of r=2/3.
What is the function of the TETRA disable and enable mechanisms?

The disable mechanism provides a secure means to disable a radio terminal using over-the-air signalling to prevent unauthorized use of a lost or stolen MS. The enable mechanism provides a secure means to restore the operation of a previously disabled radio terminal using over-the-air signalling.
What are the IV repeat cycles in TETRA for TEA set A and TEA set B?
The IV repeat cycle in TETRA is 23 days when using TEA set A and 46 days when using TEA set B.
How is the KSS handled for each new SDU on phase modulation channels?
The KSS is restarted for each new SDU.
What action should a transmitter take to avoid KSS repeat on a phase modulation channel?

The transmitter should avoid sending more than one SDU encrypted with the same encryption key within one slot, for example by delaying the transmission of SDUs using the same encryption key until later slots.
Why is PDU association more likely to be used on QAM channels than on phase modulation channels?

PDU association is more likely on QAM channels because the LLC cuts advanced link segments to fit MAC logical channel capacity fractions, and the MAC associates multiple segments into a single transmission burst. Additionally, QAM logical channels have much more capacity per slot, allowing the BS transmitter to include many more basic link PDUs in a QAM burst than in a phase modulation burst.
What is the primary purpose of using two different KSS allocation schemes on QAM channels?
The primary purpose is to eliminate most occurrences of KSS repeat within the cycle time of the IV.
How does the fixed-mapping KSS allocation scheme map KSS bits to the logical channel?

Each fixed-mapped KSS is mapped so that a defined starting bit (e.g., KSS(0) or KSS(65)) is mapped to the location of the first bit of the first MAC header. Successive KSS bits are then mapped to successive bits of the logical channel, independent of the location of the PDUs within the logical channel.
In the offset-mapping KSS allocation scheme, how is each offset-mapped KSS mapped to the MAC PDU?

Each offset-mapped KSS is mapped so that a defined starting bit (e.g. KSS(0) or KSS(65)) from the KSS corresponds to the first bit of the first MAC PDU to be encrypted with that KSS, and successive KSS bits are mapped to successive bits of PDUs encrypted using the same DCK/DCKX in the current slot or subslot.
Which modulation and coding rate combinations are permissible in the described TETRA HSD simulation?
The permissible combinations are 4-QAM with r = 1/2, 16-QAM with r = 1/2, 64-QAM with r = 1/2, 64-QAM with r = 2/3, 16-QAM with r = 1, and 64-QAM with r = 1.
How does the channel estimation approach handle mobile speed, and what is the consequence if the actual speed differs from the assumed speed?

The channel estimation uses a Bayesian-in-time linear-interpolation-in-frequency approach where the Bayesian component assumes a channel covariance matrix corresponding to a speed of 200 km/h, irrespective of the actual mobile speed. This causes the channel estimator to be mismatched with respect to the actual channel statistics when the mobile speed is different from 200 km/h.
What are the characteristics of co-channel interference in the interference limited performance scenario?

In the interference limited performance scenario, co-channel interference has the same structure as the wanted signal regarding bandwidth, burst type, modulation, and coding rate. It is shifted in frequency by 100 Hz and in time by half a symbol interval.
What assumption regarding pilot symbol spacing is made to simplify the presentation of Channel Estimation schemes, despite the actual non-uniform spacing in TETRA HSD bursts?
It is assumed that pilot symbols are uniformly spaced in both time and frequency domains.
How are the indices of subcarriers containing pilot symbols defined in terms of pilot spacing $\Delta_F$?
The pilot symbols are located on subcarriers with indices $n_1 = 0, n_2 = \Delta_F, \cdots, n_{M_F} = M_F \Delta_F$, where $N = M_F \Delta_F + 1$.
Does the IBCE method require a priori knowledge of channel statistics?
No, the IBCE method does not require any a priori knowledge of the channel statistics, making it a viable minimum-complexity implementation.
What is the primary objective of using a priori statistics in Bayesian Channel Estimation (BCE)?
The primary objective is to exploit the a priori statistics of the parameters to be estimated, such as fading samples, to obtain Minimum-Mean-Square-Error (MMSE) estimates.
How does knowing the fading covariance matrix improve Channel Estimation accuracy?

Knowing the fading covariance matrix implies having prior statistical knowledge about the correlation among neighbouring fading samples along adjacent subcarriers and/or adjacent symbols. This information can be incorporated into the CE algorithm to improve accuracy, resulting in an optimal two-dimensional estimator that minimizes Mean Square Estimation Error (MSEE) on average.
Why is a sub-optimal one-dimensional Bayesian approach often preferred over the optimal two-dimensional BCE?

The optimal two-dimensional BCE requires processing observations in two dimensions, leading to high complexity. A sub-optimal solution is devised because fading variations in time are faster than in frequency, suggesting the use of a one-dimensional Bayesian approach in time over subcarriers with pilot symbols, followed by simple linear interpolation in frequency.
What method is used to improve the accuracy of raw channel estimates on subcarriers bearing pilot symbols?
A time-domain smoothing Bayesian procedure is used to improve the accuracy of the raw channel estimates on each subcarrier bearing pilot symbols.
How is the vector of fading samples in time along the $\bar{n}$-th subcarrier denoted?
It is denoted as $\alpha_{\bar{n}}^{T}=\left[\alpha_{\bar{n}, 1}, \alpha_{\bar{n}, 2}, \cdots, \alpha_{\bar{n}, K}\right]^{T}$.
What practical solution is proposed to address the unavailability of channel statistics in BCE, and what is the consequence for slower scenarios?

The practical solution is to match the BCE to the fastest expected scenario, corresponding to a mobile speed of 200 km/h. This leads to a matched CE for TU200-400 MHz and TU200-800 MHz channels, but causes a non-negligible mismatch for slower TU50-400 MHz and TU50-800 MHz scenarios, where the normalized fading rates are 0.03 (instead of 0.0075) and 0.06 (instead of 0.015), respectively.
What assumption distinguishes the channel estimation in Figure C.2 from other simulations regarding mobile speed?
Figure C.2 assumes the estimator is aware of the actual mobile speed (ideal BCE), whereas other simulations use a fixed 200 km/h.
Why do MER curves progressively improve for growing fading bandwidth when the channel is exactly known?
MER curves improve because the turbo decoder performs better as fading samples become uncorrelated.
What causes definite MER deterioration at 300 km/h compared to 200 km/h or 250 km/h when using the Bayesian-in-time linear-interpolation-in-frequency channel estimator?
At 300 km/h, the fading bandwidth becomes so large that the spacing of pilot symbols is inadequate for correct sampling of the fading process.
MTP的全称及其中文含义是什么？
MTP的全称是Media Transfer Protocol，中文含义为媒体传输协议。
PTP指的是哪种协议？
PTP指的是Picture Transfer Protocol，即图片传输协议。
UART_TXD和UART_RXD的最大通信速率是多少？
UART_TXD和UART_RXD的最大速率均为115200bps。
How does the BT Location feature determine indoor positioning?
It is based on BT 4.0. After detecting the beacon information broadcast by the BT beacon, the radio sends the location information to the BT location data center through the public network.
How does network switching behavior differ between DMO and TMO modes?

In DMO, the radio can only communicate with other radios in the same network. In TMO, when the radio receives weak network signals or is out of service, it can switch to and register with other available networks to continue the communication.
What are the available maximum TX power settings for DMO and TMO modes?
In DMO, the maximum TX power can be set to 1.8W (32.5dBm), 1W (30dBm), 0.56W (27.5dBm), 0.3W (25dBm), or 0.18W (22.5dBm). In TMO, the settings are 1.8W (32.5dBm), 1W (30dBm), or 0.56W (27.5dBm).
What happens when the transmitting duration reaches the preset limit during an enabled Emergency Cycle?
The radio of the transmitting party automatically enters the receiving status, allowing the other party to press the PTT key to speak.
How does the Voice Operated Transmit (VOX) feature function?
VOX allows speaking without pressing and holding the PTT key; the radio automatically transmits voice when the volume reaches the preset level.
What happens when the channel is switched using the Smart Knob?
The radio automatically broadcasts the switched channel alias.
What do the abbreviations E2EE, GSDM, and PTT stand for?
E2EE stands for End-to-End Encryption, GSDM stands for Graceful Service Degradation Mode, and PTT stands for Push-to-Talk.
缩写 DTW、DHCP 和 MDM 的英文全称及中文含义分别是什么？
DTW 的英文全称是 Device Task Workstation，中文为设备任务工作站；DHCP 的英文全称是 Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol，中文为动态主机配置协议；MDM 的英文全称是 Mobile Device Management，中文为移动设备管理系统。
在 Hytera 手册中，符号【】表示什么？
该符号表示硬件界面控件名称，例如：按【PTT】键。
Which DMR terminals are listed in the reference?

The listed DMR terminals are HP70X CQST, HP78X CQST, HP79XEx, HP710Ex, HP50X CQST, HP56X CQST, HP98X, HM78X, HM68X, HM65X, HR106X, HR65X, TP530, HP68X, HP60X, HP660, HP56X, HP50X, PD78X, PD98X, PD68X, PD70X, PD75X, PD79X, PD98X UL, PD98X Ex, MD78X, and MD78Xi.
在 MDM Pro 中配置工作站时，应如何决定是否开启“安全模式”？
根据 MDM Pro 服务器的协议情况选择是否开启“安全模式”开关。
如何配置 auto_increment_increment 和 auto_increment_offset 以避免主从同步 ID 重复？
设置 auto_increment_increment=2 作为自增因子（每次加 2），并设置 auto_increment_offset=1 作为自增偏移（从 1 开始）。对于第二台服务器，偏移量应设为 2。
PTC760对讲机在哪些状态下不会产生射频能量辐射？
接收（收听）和待机时均不会产生射频能量辐射。
在对讲机集群模式下，超出网络覆盖范围时如何实现业务连续性？
对讲机开启 RoIP 网络并成功登记后，超出网络覆盖范围时，会根据宽窄网络信号自动切换网络，实现语音、数据及多媒体信息等业务。
在对讲机设置中选择中继、网关或中继和网关工作方式后，需要进行什么操作？
如果选择的工作方式为中继、网关或中继和网关，需开启自动选择设备或手动添加设备。
集群模式下，对讲机脱网后如何恢复通信？
当对讲机所在网络信号变弱或移动到覆盖范围外导致脱网时，需要切换到其他可用的网络，注册成功后可以继续通信。若配置了自动切换网络，脱网后会自动切换并注册到可用网络；若配置了多个网络，也可以手动切换到可用网络。
在集群模式下，当对讲机配置了GSDM功能且处于信号较弱、无可用小区的环境时，支持哪些通信操作？
可以接收组呼、发起或接收紧急呼叫、发送或接收紧急状态消息。
节能等级如何影响对讲机接收基站下发数据的周期？
节能等级越高，对讲机接收基站下发数据的间隔时间越长。
紧急报警在集群模式和直通模式下分别有哪些模式？
集群模式下，紧急报警模式分为紧急模式和紧急静默模式；直通模式下，紧急报警模式只有紧急模式。
在维修手册的文档约定中，符号“”和【】分别代表什么含义？
符号“”表示软件界面控件名称，例如单击“确定”；符号【】表示硬件界面控件名称，例如按【PTT】键。
CODEC的18.432MHz时钟信号来源是什么？
CODEC的18.432MHz时钟通过C6746 A2脚获得。
C67 模块在窄带通信发送通路中对信号进行哪些处理后经由射频发送？
C67 模块对信号进行降噪、AGC 等操作后，经由射频发送出去。
CAT4 射频接收到的语音信号在进入 Codec 进行 DAC 转换之前，需要经过哪些 DSP 处理步骤？
DSP 对接收到的信号进行均衡、降噪等处理。
codec 对接收到的信号进行哪些处理？
增益调节、DA 转换等处理。
模拟信号转换为数字信号后，最终通过什么方式输出并与 DSP 交互？
差频信号经 ADC 采样之后将模拟信号变为数字信号，最后数字信号通过 A/D 口输出与 DSP 进行交互处理。
基准晶振产生的18.432 MHz频率进入PLL IC后如何形成参考频率f1？
基准晶振产生的18.432 MHz频率进入PLL IC（U6100）的滤波器进行分频，形成参考频率f1（即步进频率）。
在接收信号时，U6300第4脚、U2301第4脚和U2301第1脚的电压分别是多少？
U6300第4脚电压为3.3V左右，U2301第4脚电压为3.8V左右，U2301第1脚电压为3.3V左右。
What is the requirement for using BT earpieces from other companies to ensure they can transmit?
You must use them with the wireless ring PTT of the Company. Otherwise, the earpieces cannot transmit.
What does the LED indicator do when Scan is enabled and when it detects activities on a channel?
When Scan is enabled, the LED indicator flashes orange slowly. When detecting activities on a channel, the radio stays on the channel, and the LED indicator glows green.
What is the function of the Scrambler feature and how can it be toggled?

Scrambler allows the radio to invert the frequency spectrum of transmitted audio signals, preventing eavesdropping. Only the receiving radio with the same Scrambler settings can restore the audio signals. To turn it on or off, go to Menu > Settings > Radio, select Scrambler, and press the OK/Menu key, or press the preprogrammed Scrambler key.
Under what conditions is Talk Around useful and how is it activated if configured?

Talk Around allows you to continue communication in direct mode when the repeater malfunctions or your radio is out of the coverage of the repeater. If the channel is configured with Talk Around, press the preprogrammed Talk Around key to turn it on or off.
What does DMR represent in digital mobile radio communications?
DMR represents Digital Mobile Radio.
What is the full form and Chinese meaning of PDT?
PDT stands for Police Digital Trunking, which translates to 警用数字集群.
文档中符号“”和【】分别表示什么意义？
符号“”表示软件界面控件名称，例如：单击“确定”。符号【】表示硬件界面控件名称，例如：按【PTT】键。
该收发机在UHF和VHF频段下的发射功率分别是多少？
UHF频段的发射功率为1W或4W，VHF频段的发射功率为1W或5W。
该收发机支持的信道间隔有哪些规格？
支持的信道间隔为25kHz、20kHz和12.5kHz。
在TIA-603标准下，该收发机在不同信道间隔时的邻道选择性指标是多少？
在TIA-603标准下，12.5kHz信道间隔时的邻道选择性为60dB，20kHz和25kHz信道间隔时为70dB。
How do you switch between DMO and TMO on the terminal?
Go to Settings > PMR > Work mode, and then tap DMO or TMO.
What does it indicate when the LED indicator flashes orange slowly?
It indicates that the terminal is registering in TMO.
Under what condition is the rapid orange flashing of the LED indicator applicable?
Rapid orange flashing indicates establishing a call with hook signaling in TMO, and this indication is applicable only to the called terminal.
What should be done if the data connection feature is not enabled for the micro-SIM card?
Contact the carrier to enable the data connection feature.
What are the communication constraints in DMO compared to TMO when signals are weak?

In DMO, the radio can only communicate with other radios in the same network. In TMO, when the radio receives weak network signals or is out of service, it can switch to and register with other available networks to continue the communication.
What happens when the Auto-switch network feature is enabled in TMO?
With Auto-switch network enabled, the radio automatically switches to another network when it is out of service.
What happens when the transmitting duration of one party reaches the preset limit during an Emergency Cycle?
The radio of that party automatically enters the receiving status, allowing the other party to press the PTT key to speak. This process repeats until the cycle times expire.
What happens when the channel is switched using the Smart Knob with Voice Broadcast enabled?
The radio automatically broadcasts the switched channel alias.
What are the steps to insert Nano SIM and Micro SD cards?
Open the card slot cover, insert the Nano SIM cards into the corresponding slots, optionally insert the Micro SD cards with metal contacts facing down, and put the card slot cover back in place.
How do you switch the channel using the Smart Knob?
Press the Smart Knob, and then rotate the knob within 5 seconds.
What actions can exit the emergency mode triggered by the Lone Worker feature?
You can press any keys, rotate the Smart Knob, or press the PTT key and speak.
What is the BT Location feature and how does it transmit location information?

The BT Location feature is an indoor positioning technology. After detecting beacon information broadcast by the BT beacon, the radio sends the location information to the BT location data center through the public network.
What is the roam list?
The roam list is a list of digital repeater channels where the radio roams.
How can you resolve the issue when the mobile data feature is disabled for the SIM card?
Contact the carrier to enable the mobile data feature.
该设备支持哪些无线电数据通信制式及其对应的频段或标准？

支持TETRA (350-470MHz, 806-870MHz)、LTE (3GPP LTE，含FDD-LTE B1/B2/B3/B4/B5/B7/B8/B20/B26/B28*及TDD-LTE B38/B39/B40/B41)、CDMA (CDMA 1xRTT BC0*, CDMA2000 1xEV-DO BC0)、WCDMA (B1/B2/B4/B5/B8)、TD-SCDMA (B34/B39)以及GSM (850/900/1800/1900MHz*)。
为什么基站提供的定位信息偏差较大？
因为基站分布较稀疏，且终端与基站距离通常较远。
What is the function of the Priority interrupt feature?
It allows you to interrupt the ongoing call, call hang, and remote monitor on the current channel to release it, enabling you to initiate a new call or a new data service on that channel.
What is the purpose of the Handover feature and when does it activate?

The Handover feature allows the radio to automatically register with the BS with stronger signal. It activates when the signal strength received from a BS fluctuates due to position change, affecting the communication quality of the radio.
How does the Home Station Hunt feature function in a BS overlapping area?
It allows the radio to switch back to the home station channel when its signal strength reaches the preset threshold.
How does the VOX feature enable hands-free transmission?
When the microphone on the earpiece detects voice reaching the preset volume level, the radio automatically starts transmitting, eliminating the need to press and hold the PTT key.
What is the function of Background Hunt?

It allows an idle radio to keep detecting the signal strength of the BS with which it registers. If the signal strength goes below the threshold level preset by the dealer, the radio will automatically hunt for an adjacent BS with stronger signal strength and register with it.
What is the purpose of Home Station Hunt in a BS overlapping area?
It allows the radio to switch back to the home station channel when its signal strength reaches the preset threshold.
What are the limitations regarding the Roam list configuration?
The roam list consists of digital repeater channels. Either the Scan feature or the Roam feature can be enabled for the same digital channel, but the direct channel cannot be set with a roam list.
How does the Single Frequency Repeater feature allocate slots for signal transmission and reception?
It assigns one slot to receive signals and the other slot to transmit signals using the same frequency and color code.
What are the methods to turn on the Single Frequency Repeater feature?

You can tap the icon and then tap Single frequency repeater, press the preprogrammed Single frequency repeater key, or rely on the Auto Open SFR feature if configured on the digital channel to activate it automatically when switching to the channel.
What steps should be taken if you cannot communicate with group members?

Verify that your TX/RX frequency and signaling type match those of other members. Ensure all members are on the same digital or analog channel type. Move closer to other members if distance is an issue, and confirm everyone is within the communication range.
Which audio accessory is a Wireless PTT?
POA121
What is the maximum rated duty factor for transmission, and how is transmission controlled?
The maximum rated duty factor is 50% of the time. To transmit, push the Push-To-Talk (PTT) key; to receive calls, release the PTT key.
基站的用户类别与终端的用户类别在性质上有何区别？
基站的用户类别是固定的、静态的；终端的用户类别是动态变化的，用于控制小区选择。
在大型事件中，过频繁的小区漫游会导致什么后果？
会导致系统信道资源的大量占用，产生业务阻塞，导致终端无法正常通信。
终端识别出关联用户类别后，会执行哪些操作以支持小区重选？
终端会通知协议栈更新终端用户类别，并重新匹配终端和基站的用户类别，从而为小区重选提供依据。
如果BS设置终端用户类型由基站控制，终端进行切组或切夹操作时，其用户类别是否会更新？
不会更新。终端会一直使用基站分配的SC直到离开当前注册的小区。
在发起紧急组呼的附属过程中，为什么终端不修改用户类别？
为了避免因紧急组关联的用户类别与基站不匹配，导致更新后出现脱网从而无法发起紧急呼叫的严重问题。
当“关联类型”为“通话组区间”且配置的“起始组呼号”大于“终止组呼号”时，系统如何响应？
“起始组呼号”值会变成跟“终止组呼号”值一样，并提示用户：起始组呼号必须小于或等于终止组呼号。
What are the definitions of TMO and DMO?
TMO stands for Trunked Mode Operation (集群模式), and DMO stands for Direct Mode Operation (直通模式).
SCK subset number的修改方式及持久化要求是什么？
SCK subset number可以由用户设置，也可以通过基站OTAR信令修改。修改后的值需保存到终端的文件系统中，确保可以读取，且终端重启后该参数不能丢失。
基站如何向终端提供DMO SCK subset number？
基站通过下发信令D-CK CHANGE DEMAND向终端提供DMO SCK subset number。
基站通过什么信令向终端提供对应subset number的DMO SCK？
基站通过信令D-OTAR SCK PROVIDE向终端提供对应subset number的DMO SCK给终端使用。
收到MMI下发的Subset Number后应如何处理？
将该值提供给协议栈。
当基站通过 OTAR 下发 DMO SCK 及使用的 SCK subset number 时，终端如何处理这些数据？
终端保存到文件系统中。
PDC680/PTC680开机后，如何通过【智能】旋钮调节音量以及选择联系人或信道？
顺时针旋转【智能】旋钮可以增大音量，逆时针旋转可以减小音量。按下【智能】旋钮，屏幕会弹出提示框，此时旋转该旋钮可以选择联系人或信道。
在集群模式下，DIRECT 呼叫的接听方式是什么？
自动建立呼叫。您无需任何操作即可接听。
What does DMR refer to in digital mobile communications?
DMR refers to Digital Mobile Radio (数字移动对讲机).
PDT refers to which digital trunking system?
PDT refers to Police Digital Trunking.
PDC机型在常规模式和集群模式下发送紧急警报后，终端分别会进入什么状态？
在PDC常规模式下，紧急警报发送完毕后，终端将回到待机状态。在PDC集群模式下，发送警报后，终端将进入等待回呼状态；等待回呼状态超时后，再回到待机状态。
PDC集群模式下，紧急警报或呼叫的等待回呼结束后界面如何变化？
等待回呼结束后，再回到警报接收界面。
当报警发送ID为组呼ID时，按PTT回呼的对象是谁？
对此组进行回呼。
当报警发送ID为个呼ID时，按PTT回呼的对象是谁？
对报警发起方进行回呼。
集群模式下主叫方显示红色快闪代表什么状态？
代表正在建立呼叫。
What are the supported frequency ranges for UHF and VHF in the DMR Analog and ETSI DMR Tier II/III communication standards?
The supported frequency range for UHF is 350 to 527 MHz, and for VHF it is 136 to 174 MHz.
数据卡切换过程中对各类业务有什么具体影响？
切换数据卡时，不会令语音/视频通话、数据传输下载等业务失败，但会导致呼叫类的业务中断，可能出现掉字的情况。
窄带 TETRA 终端插件的文件名是什么？
G1_Tetra_UserClient_V2.0.08.000.01plug
常规选项配置中，协议 (R) 和端口号 (Q) 分别设置为什么？
协议 (R) 设置为 SFTP，端口号 (Q) 设置为 22。
What is the first step in DMR Radio Management?
Connect the radio to the MDM SE.
What action follows adding the OTAP template in TETRA Radio Management?
Program the radio through OTAP.
Where can you view the task status when writing into the DMR radio through a template?
Go to DMR > Task.
宽窄带切组同步功能的主要目的是什么？
为了让使用MPUC进行宽窄互通业务的用户在切组时，宽窄带切组能同步切换。
当用户切换窄带通话组时，PoC侧如何响应以实现同步？
PoC会同步切到关联的POC宽带组。
PTC680和PTC760机型属于哪类设备，支持什么工作模式？
属于多模TETRA机型，支持“DMO”和“TMO”工作模式。
当前MPUC宽窄互通方案下，切组同步功能支持哪种通话类型和组类型？
由于当前MPUC宽窄互通是背靠背方案且只支持组呼，因此切组同步也只支持组呼。在组类型方面，仅支持静态组，不支持动态组。
开启切组同步功能后，可以对窄带通话组进行什么操作？
开启此功能后，可对文件夹中的窄带通话组设置关联 POC 宽带组，亦可将关联设为空。
当用户切换窄带当前信道、当前组或默认组时，POC 宽带组会如何响应？如果找不到对应组会发生什么？
POC 会同步切换至相同名称的 POC 宽带组。若 POC 找不到该通话组，会弹出 toast 提示：“宽带系统不存在此通话组（The talkgroup does not exist in BB）”。
当用户切换 POC 宽带组时，窄带侧会如何同步？若窄带系统中不存在同名通话组，界面将显示什么提示？
窄带会同步切换至相同名称的窄带当前信道（常规）、当前组（集群）或默认组（TMO）。若窄带找不到该通话组，会弹出 toast 提示：“窄带系统不存在此通话组（The talkgroup does not exist in NB）”。
常规集群DMO在PoC通知窄带进行切组时的确定策略是否与常规模式相同？
是，常规集群DMO同理。
如何设置终端上“切组同步”菜单项的可见性？
通过增加切组同步菜单开关进行设置。具体路径为：“整机 > 菜单 > 菜单”，在其中增加“切组同步”设置项。
如何通过写频设置开启或关闭切组同步功能？
通过增加切组同步功能开关进行设置。具体路径为：“整机 > 业务设置 > 语音业务”，在其中增加“切组同步”开关项。
该设备的无线数据通信支持哪些频段和制式？
窄带支持400MHz~470MHz；LTE支持FDD B1/B3/B5/B8以及TDD B34/B38/B39/B40/B41（140MHz）；GSM支持900MHz/1800MHz。
CAT4 射频接收到的语音信号在进入 DSP 后，会经过哪些处理步骤？
DSP 对接收到的信号进行均衡、降噪等处理。
Codec 对输入的模拟信号进行处理后，通过什么接口输出给受话器？
通过 HPLOUT 和 HPLCOM 差分输出给受话器。
codec对接收到的信号主要进行哪些处理？
增益调节、DA转换等处理。
发射信号在经过末级功放和微带线处理后，最后依次经过哪些组件？
最后发射信号经过收发通路切换开关进入低通滤波器。
DSP产生的调制信号如何实现两点调制平衡，其性能指标是多少？
DSP产生的调制信号分两路：一路对VCO进行高口调制，另一路输出到PLL IC进行直接调制。当这两路信号的相位与幅度达到一定比例时，两点调制达到平衡，调制频率在100Hz~6kHz范围内的响应平坦度为±0.4dB。
单北斗双频信号中 L1 和 L5 信号的处理流程及最终输入位置是什么？
单北斗双频信号经 Z9204 分频为 L1（1561.098）和 L5（1176.45）信号，分别由 U9203、U9202 进行放大。L1 信号通过开关 U9204 拉至高电平，BD 信号经 U9204 ANT 至 RF2 端口传输至 Z9201，再与 L5 信号合路后输入至 U9201 双频 BD 模块。
发射部分包含哪些具体的调测项？
发射部分的调测项包括：参考频率、发射功率、参考频偏和调制平衡。
在调测参考频率时，如何连接设备并设置 HP8921？
连接终端的天线端口与 HP8921 的 RF 端口，并将 HP8921 设置为发射测试模式。同时通过附件音频调试线连接终端、PC 和 HP8921。
在 Tuner 软件中调整参考频率时，频率误差应控制在什么范围内？
通过调整 Tuner 软件界面上的游标，使频率误差小于“±30Hz”。
在调制平衡调测中，调整 LOW_PORT 信道的具体步骤和目标频偏值是多少？
单击 “LOW_PORT” 下面该信道的数值对话框，然后单击“发射开”启动发射，此时设备的调制信号为 “100Hz”。观察 HP8921 中显示的频偏值，通过调整 Tuner 软件界面对话框中的参数值或对话框旁上下箭头，使频偏值为 4.95kHz ±0.05kHz。
完成当前信道的所有频偏项调整后，必须执行什么操作才能确保调整结果被保存？
必须切换到下一个信道，否则这次的调整结果不会被保存到终端中。
在进行射频信号设置时，HP8921 应输出什么样的信号，以及如何连接设备？
需连接终端的天线端口与 HP8921 的 RF 端口，并将 HP8921 设置为接收测试模式，同时通过附件音频调试线连接终端、PC 和 HP8921。HP8921 应输出 “-47dBm/Frequency（当前信道频率值）” 的带调制的射频信号。
如何调整 HP8921 显示的频率误差使其满足要求？
通过调整 Tuner 软件界面上的游标，使频率误差小于 ±30 Hz。
Which keys should be added when the E2EE Type is TETRA E2EE?
Users need to add the KEK keys when E2EE Type is TETRA E2EE.
What does the abbreviation DMR stand for?
DMR stands for Digital Mobile Radio.
术语 DMR、DTW 和 MDM 分别代表什么含义？
DMR 代表数字移动对讲机 (Digital Mobile Radio)，DTW 代表设备任务工作站 (Device Task Workstation)，MDM 代表移动设备管理系统 (Mobile Device Management)。
PDT 和 TETRA 的全称及中文含义分别是什么？
PDT 的全称是 Police Digital Trunking，中文含义为警用数字集群；TETRA 的全称是 Terrestrial Trunked Radio，中文含义为陆地集群无线电系统。
窄带 TETRA 终端需要使用哪个驱动？
PL-2303 USB-to-Serial Driver
实现中转功能需要几个频率，有什么优势？
只需一个单频率即可实现中转功能，其优势是节省频率资源。
工作频率的设置方式及其作用是什么？
工作频率可现场设置或修改调整，以满足实际工程需要并有效避免干扰源。
直通模式下的中继器功能包含哪几种类型？
直通模式下的中继器功能包含2种类型，分别是Type1和Type2。
类型1中继器分为哪两种类型？
类型1中继器分为A型和B型。
类型1A中继器的收发操作有何特点？
类型1A中继器的接收和发送操作都在单一载波上进行，且收发使用不同的时隙。
在类型1B中继器中，上行和下行分别指什么？
从终端到中继器的部分称为上行，中继器到终端的部分称为下行。
类型 2 中继器的空中接口支持多少路通话同时进行？
类型 2 中继器的空中接口可以支持两路通话同时进行。
在中继模式下触发紧急呼叫键后，终端的行为流程是什么？
退出中继模式后切换到 DMO 模式，再发起 DMO 紧急呼叫。
在同频中转过程中，终端的发射功率、时隙行为及 UI 显示有何特征？
同频中转过程默认采用高功率发射（转发时功率图标为 H）。开启后，在时隙 1 收到业务，时隙 2 强制采用非礼貌发射，且不响应时隙 2 的任何业务。UI 方面：转发数据和信令时无其他提示（除红色 LED 和高功率外）；转发语音时，支持加密语音指示、紧急呼叫指示、讲话方别名显示及存储呼叫记录；正在中转业务时，显示讲话方 ID 或别名及转发双箭头。
在不支持发送信令和数据业务的场景下，如果尝试发送数据会发生什么？
会响错误提示音。
通过 SFR 可编程功能开启同频中转功能时，对信道有什么要求？如果不满足要求会有什么提示？
必须在支持 SFR 信道。否则响错误提示音，提示“当前信道不支持同频中转”。
使用终端菜单开启同频中转功能时，是否受 SFR 功能信道支持的限制？
不受限制，即使不支持 SFR 功能信道同样允许操作。
在支持自动开启同频中转功能的数字信道上，整机 SFR 功能的状态如何变化？
无论整机 SFR 功能是否开启，切换到该信道时都会自动开启 SFR 功能。此时菜单 Setting-Call Setting-SFR 状态会临时变成开启，当切换到非 Auto SFR 信道时，SFR 状态将恢复为进入前的状态。
当从支持自动开启同频中转功能的数字信道切换到非 Auto SFR 信道时，SFR 设置会发生什么？
SFR 状态会恢复到进入支持自动开启同频中转功能信道之前的状态。
同频中转功能开启后，切换到不同信道时其启动状态如何变化？
同频中转开启后为整机状态。若切换到支持 SFR 功能的信道，则同频中转功能启动；若切换到不支持 SFR 的信道，同频中转功能不启动。
通过可编程方式关闭同频中转功能与通过菜单关闭有何区别，特别是在不支持 SFR 功能的信道上？
支持 SFR 可编程功能关闭同频中转功能时，在不支持 SFR 功能的信道上会响错误提示音；而支持菜单关闭同频中转功能时，即使在不支持 SFR 功能的信道上同样允许操作。
哪些场景属于优先业务打断场景？
优先业务打断场景包括：关机、切信道、收发报警、被遥控、租赁到期、扫描停留时按“噪声信道删除”。
通过菜单将信道频率从同频修改为异频后，信道上的 SFR 功能状态会发生什么变化？如何恢复？
信道上 SFR 功能会修改成关闭。修改信道频率会造成 SFR 功能不能使用，且只能通过写频恢复。
当直通与SFR转发在同频1/2时隙都有信号时，系统为何不选择语音质量更好的信号接入？
因为直通信号要快于SFR信号，如果优选语音质量好的信号接入，可能会存在掉字或重复音情况。
目前1跳SFR在直通与SFR转发同频信号处理上存在什么问题？
存在与直通和SFR转发同频2时隙信号相同的问题，即当1/2时隙都有信号时，没有选择语音质量更好的信号接入。
PDT集群下的对讲机ID对应哪个终端标签项？
RadioID(数字集群)
MPT集群模式下的对讲机ID在终端标签中如何标识？
RadioID(模拟集群)
在常规模式、PDT集群模式和MPT集群模式下，分别使用哪个ID作为对讲机ID？
常规模式下使用RadioID，PDT集群模式下使用PDTRadioID，MPT集群模式下使用MPTRadioID。
DMO模式下呼叫优先级的等级排列及资源抢占规则是什么？
DMO模式下的呼叫优先级由低到高依次为普通优先级、高优先级、预占优先级。当低优先级呼叫占用信道资源时，高优先级呼叫可打断低优先级呼叫以获得信道资源。
终端发起个呼或组呼时，若优先级设置为“未定义”，系统将如何处理？
若个呼或组呼的优先级设置为“未定义”，则以系统为终端设置的呼叫优先级为准。
开启“广播呼叫优先”功能后，终端接入广播组呼的行为有何变化？
开启该功能后，终端将优先接入其他终端或调度台发起的广播组呼，以保证接入更及时；若不开启，系统将根据“使用等级”来接入广播呼叫。
What does the acronym ITSI stand for in TETRA systems, and how is it composed?
ITSI stands for Individual TETRA Subscriber Identity. It is composed of the country code, network code, and ISSI.
What are the full names and Chinese translations for AIE and OTAK?
AIE stands for Air Interface Encryption (空口加密), and OTAK stands for Over The Air Key Management (空口密钥管理).
海能达全域定位方案的定位速度和位置更新频率是多少？
定位速度达到秒级定位，冷启动时间小于等于10秒；最快1秒更新一次位置信息。
PDC760对讲机在哪些状态下不会产生射频能量辐射？
接收（收听）和待机时均不会产生射频能量辐射。
什么是包容呼叫，它目前支持哪种组呼类型？
包容呼叫是集群模式下对讲机在通话保持过程中，可以邀请新的组呼联系人加入到该通话中。目前包容呼叫仅支持普通组呼。
在常规模式下如何设置信道的发射功率？
在常规模式下，点击“对讲机联系人”或“对讲机”，点击“区域”。选择某个数字信道或模拟信道，点击并设置发射功率。
固定控制信道扫描下有哪些扫描模式，其中“短扫描”的具体流程是什么？
若预设了固定控制信道扫描，可选择短扫描、全面扫描或段扫描三种模式。短扫描的流程是：先扫描最近登记成功的信道，若未成功，则依次扫描邻近基站信道和固定控制信道列表中的信道，直到登记成功。
在数字信道上使用【一键呼叫/消息】快捷键发起呼叫时，需要注意什么操作顺序？
在数字信道上发起呼叫时，需在按【一键呼叫/消息】快捷键后再按【PTT】键。
在常规模式的数字信道中，如何发起对讲机检查以确认对方状态？
点击“对讲机联系人”或“对讲机”，点击“通讯录”，选择“常用”或“个呼”列表中的个呼联系人，进入联系人详情界面，选择发起补充业务。
该设备在TIA-603标准下的邻道选择性指标是多少？
在TIA-603标准下，12.5kHz信道间隔时的邻道选择性为60dB，20/25kHz信道间隔时为70dB。
该设备UHF和VHF频段的发射功率分别是多少？
UHF频段发射功率为1W或4W，VHF频段发射功率为1W或5W。
模拟集群模式支持哪些音频处理功能和安全机制？
模拟集群模式支持的音频处理功能为声反馈抑制，安全机制为鉴权。
AIE 在通信领域代表什么全称及其中文含义？
AIE 的全称是 Air Interface Encryption，中文含义为空口加密。
DMR 技术指的是哪种通信系统？
DMR 指的是 Digital Mobile Radio，即数字移动对讲机。
What is the full form of PDT in the context of digital trunking?
PDT stands for Police Digital Trunking.
How is the name of a hardware button denoted in the text notation?
The name of a hardware button is denoted by text in boldface. For example, press the PTT key.
How does the Tetra/DMR button indicate the current radio type in KMC?
The Tetra/DMR button shows the current radio type. For example, when it displays "TETRA", users create encryption keys for Tetra radios.
在 Smart MDM 异地容灾方案中，当主备服务无法互相访问时，如何进行切换决策？
通过 HTTP 协议由仲裁节点确认当前主备服务的可用性，指导主服务器和备用服务器进行切换。
.pdt 或 .dmr 格式文件的主要用途是什么？
用于 DMR/PDT 终端新建集群鉴权密钥。
对于 DMR 终端，应将终端类型选择为什么？
应将终端类型选择为 DMR。
对于 PDT 终端，应将终端类型选择为什么？
应将终端类型选择为 PDT。
在“新建集群”步骤中，如何完成文件名的设置？
在弹出的“新建文件”窗口中输入文件名后单击“确定”。
Which public networks can the Hytera PDC680 connect to for seamless communications alongside the DMR network?
The device supports seamless communications with public networks such as 2G, 3G, LTE, and WLAN.
宽窄带融合集群通信系统具有哪些主要特征？
基于本文件的宽窄融合集群通信系统具有核心网统一、业务流程一致、接口标准化、接入模式多样的特征。
该文件规定了宽窄带融合集群通信系统的哪些具体内容？
本文件规定了宽窄带融合集群通信系统的总体原则、系统功能和性能要求、系统架构、接口要求、工作频段和带宽、编号和寻址、网络管理和安全加密。
该文件适用于宽窄带融合集群通信系统的哪些环节？
本文件适用于宽窄带融合集群通信系统的规划、网络设计、设备开发、生产、工程建设和验收。
宽窄带融合集群通信系统在接入模式、业务流程和安全方面有哪些核心特征？
该系统采用统一的集群核心网，同时支持宽带LTE和窄带PDT接入模式；采用一致的业务流程、标准化的网元接口和统一的号码规划；支持鉴权、空口安全和端到端安全等功能，并采用国产加密算法。
宽窄带融合集群通信系统中的“动态重组”是指什么过程？动态组的有效期是如何规定的？
动态重组是授权网管设备或调度台利用空口信令向目标移动终端临时增加通话组（动态组）的过程。移动终端新增加的动态组在收到删除该动态组的信令前一直有效。
宽窄带融合集群通信系统的非摘机半双工语音单呼建立时间指标要求是多少？
非摘机半双工语音单呼建立时间不超过500ms。
集群核心网（TCN）包含哪些主要功能模块或单元？
集群核心网（TCN）由演进的移动管理单元（eMME）、演进的核心网网关（eXGW）、演进的归属用户服务器（eHSS）、集群控制功能模块（TCM）和集群媒体功能模块（TMM）组成。
集群调度应用平台由哪些部分组成？
集群调度应用平台由调度台、录音录像服务器、安全服务器和应用服务器组成。
集群核心网分别通过哪些接口与数据业务网和互联网关连接？
集群核心网通过SGi接口与数据业务网相连，通过PG接口与互联网关相连。
宽窄带融合集群通信系统中，漫游业务由哪一方控制？
漫游业务由归属地控制。
漫游移动终端在拜访地如何访问归属地集群核心网？
漫游移动终端在拜访地，通过集群核心网间PI接口访问归属地集群核心网。
调度台（DC）通过什么接口与集群核心网相连？
调度台（DC）通过PD1接口与集群核心网相连。
PS1和PS2接口分别连接哪些网元，并支持哪些功能？
PS1是连接T-eNB和TCN之间的接口，PS2是连接PDT基站和TCN之间的接口。两者均应支持集群相关的接入控制、移动性和承载管理等功能。
How can you switch between DMO and TMO modes?
Go to Settings > PMR > Work mode, and then tap DMO or TMO.
AIE、E2EE 和 OTAK 分别代表什么术语？
AIE 代表空口加密 (Air Interface Encryption)，E2EE 代表端到端加密 (End-to-End Encryption)，OTAK 代表空口密钥管理 (Over-The-Air-Key Management)。
PDT 和 TETRA 是哪种通信系统的缩写？
PDT 是警用数字集群 (Police Digital Trunking) 的缩写，TETRA 是陆地集群无线电 (Terrestrial Trunked Radio) 的缩写。
DMR、KMS、MDM 和 SCK 分别指代什么？
DMR 指数字移动对讲机 (Digital Mobile Radio)，KMS 指密钥管理系统 (Key Management System)，MDM 指移动设备管理系统 (Mobile Device Management)，SCK 指静态密钥 (Static Cipher Key)。
QEU/ENS集群状态消息采用什么编码方式，共有多少种状态？
QEU/ENS集群状态消息使用7-bit编码，共128种状态。其中一部分为系统消息与系统预留，其余为用户自定义。
终端接收到系统下发的等待后续信令（C_WACKD）后，会执行什么操作？
启动定时器TNP_Timer。
QEU集群模式支持多少个自定义状态编码？
QEU集群模式支持95个自定义状态编码，编码范围为032～126。
ENS集群Hytera模式支持的自定义状态编码范围及数量是多少？
ENS集群Hytera模式支持000~126共127个自定义状态编码。
ENS集群标准模式支持多少个自定义状态编码？
ENS集群标准模式支持100个自定义状态编码，编码范围为000~099。
What is the full name of TETRA?
Terrestrial Trunked Radio (陆地集群无线电)
What is the full name of the abbreviation DMR?
Digital Mobile Radio
What is the full form of TETRA?
Terrestrial Trunked Radio
How do RX and TX frequencies relate in DMO mode versus repeater mode?

In DMO mode, the RX frequency and the TX frequency are the same. In repeater mode, the frequencies are different: the radio's RX frequency matches the repeater's TX frequency, and the radio's TX frequency matches the repeater's RX frequency.
What is the minimum requirement for a scan list before scanning can be enabled?
A scan list must have two or more channels.
What is the full form of the abbreviation TETRA?
Terrestrial Trunked Radio.
《应急专用数字集群(ePDT)通信系统技术规范》第1部分的主要目的是什么？
规范ePDT通信系统的系统构成、接口要求、系统互联要求。
《应急专用数字集群(ePDT)通信系统技术规范》第8部分主要规范哪些内容？
规范ePDT通信系统的功能、性能、接口测试方法。
本文件适用于应急专用数字集群(ePDT)通信系统的哪些环节？
适用于总体规划、网络设计、设备开发、生产、工程建设和验收。
针对基于12.5 kHz信道的TDMA专用数字集群通信系统，其空中接口物理层及数据链路层的技术规范对应哪个标准号？
对应的标准号是GB/T 34991。
警用数字集群(PDT)通信系统的互联技术规范遵循什么标准？
警用数字集群(PDT)通信系统的互联技术规范遵循GA/T 1364标准。
FOACSU 指的是哪种呼叫方式？
FOACSU 指的是手动摘机呼叫，英文全称为 Full Off Air Call Set-Up。
OACSU 代表什么功能？
OACSU 代表自动摘机呼叫 (Off Air Call Set-Up)。
pSIP 协议的全称是什么？
pSIP 协议的全称是 PDT Session Initiation Protocol，即 PDT会话初始协议。
ePDT通信系统在370 MHz～390 MHz频段内的信道划分规则是什么？
在370 MHz～390 MHz频段内，应按12.5 kHz信道间隔划分载波信道，并采用时分复用/时分多址(TDMA)技术划分时隙信道，每载波为两个时隙。
ePDT通信系统的上行和下行频率范围分别是多少？
ePDT通信系统的频率间隔是多少？
ePDT通信系统频率间隔为12.5 kHz。
集群频率分组使用时应遵循哪些原则？
集群频率宜按照无三阶互调的组合分成若干组使用，每组频率没有邻频关系，且最小频率间距应满足合路器的要求。
腔体合路器和软合路设备的最小频率间隔分别是多少？
腔体合路器最小频率间隔应为 250 kHz，软合路设备最小频率间隔应为 50 kHz。
LAI由哪三部分组成？
LAI由省级码（省、自治区、直辖市）(Zone)、地市码 (LAIa) 和基站码 (LAlb) 三段组成。
同一地市下的基站的LAI是否可以复用？
同一地市下的基站的 LAI 不宜复用。
在地市码和基站码的分配中，对于地理位置相邻的地市有什么限制？
地理位置相邻的地市不应使用相同的地市码。
UUID 中用于指示单呼或组呼地址的附加位有多少，UUID 为 0 时表示什么？
UUID 中附加 1 bit 用于指示 UUID 为单呼或组呼地址。UUID 为 0 时表示空号(NULL)。
在 SSI 地址中，哪些数值代表短单呼用户地址？
SSI 中 1 ~ 32200 为短单呼用户地址。
SSI 值为 0 以及 32201 ~ 32767 分别代表什么含义？
SSI 值为 0 为空号；32201 ~ 32767 为短特殊呼叫地址。
完整的段队单呼号码由哪几部分组成，总长度是多少？
完整的段队单呼号码为 8 位，编码方式为 NP(3 位) + FIN(2 位) + IN(3 位)。
5 位和 3 位的段队单呼号码分别采用什么编码方式？
5 位段队单呼号码编码方式为 FIN(2 位) + IN(3 位)；3 位段队单呼号码编码方式为 IN(3 位)。
在 SGI 编码中，哪些数值分别代表空号、组呼用户号码和全呼号码？
0 为空号，1 ~ 17000 为组呼用户号码，32767 为全呼号码。
SGI 中除空号、组呼用户号码和全呼号码外的其他地址如何定义？
其他地址保留。
ePDT 的段队组呼号码编码应采用什么标准？
ePDT 的段队组呼号码编码应采用段队组呼编码。
完整的组呼号码由哪几部分组成，总长度是多少？
完整的组呼号码为8位，编码方式为 NP(3位) + FGN(2位) + GN(3位)。
5位段队组呼号码和3位段队组呼号码的编码方式分别是什么？
5位段队组呼号码编码方式为 FGN(2位) + GN(3位)；3位段队组呼号码编码方式为 GN(3位)。
每个区号内段队组呼号码总数是多少，对应的短组呼地址范围是什么？
每个区号内段队组呼号码总数是7000个，段队组呼对应的短组呼地址范围为 1~7000。
应急频率编号1927对应的频率是多少MHz？
应急频率编号2057对应的频率是多少MHz？
频率为374.1500/384.1500 MHz的应急频率编号是多少？
应急频率编号2225对应的频率是多少MHz？
顶屏图标“Tx”指示了集群模式下的何种网络状况？
集群模式下，网络无信号。
NTG（宣告组）在集群模式下的默认使用等级是什么？当默认组分别为宣告组和关联组时，对讲机的监听行为有何不同？
NTG（宣告组）的使用等级默认为高级。当默认组为宣告组时，对讲机将监听与宣告组关联的通话组列表；当默认组为关联组时，对讲机将始终监听其关联的宣告组。
在集群系统允许对讲机挂断的情况下，主叫和被叫结束呼叫的效果分别是什么？
主叫点击或按键结束呼叫，被叫挂机仅自身退出呼叫。
在集群系统不允许对讲机挂断的情况下，主叫点击或按键以及被叫的状态分别是怎样的？
主叫点击或按键仅自身退出呼叫，被叫处于信道保留状态。
在组呼通话中，如何实现对每个成员讲话内容的单独录音及查看？
需点击“对讲设置”，点击“会话式录音”并开启。开启后，系统会自动对组呼通话中每个成员的讲话进行录音，并在组呼信息界面中展示，方便通话结束后重新收听。
在集群模式下，如何让会话录音显示发送时的位置信息？
需要开启“会话式录音存储位置信息”功能。开启后，每条会话录音还可以显示发送时的位置信息。
声控模式适用于什么场景，触发条件是什么？
声控模式适用于用户双手无空暇的情况。它通过检测声音来自动激活发射模块，无需按压 PTT，且当前仅支持通过耳塞式配件来触发声控。
开启对讲机的语音播报功能后，通过【智能】旋钮切换信道时会发生什么？
对讲机会自动播报切换后的信道别名。
集群模式下，“只允许注册优先小区”策略的具体行为是什么？
在“只允许注册优先小区”策略下，对讲机只允许注册优先小区列表中的小区。
集群模式下的组呼探测功能是如何实现的，其触发和退出时机是什么？
组呼探测通过状态消息实现带确认组呼功能。调度台发起组呼且呼叫建立成功后，向参与对讲机发送指定状态消息，对讲机收到后自动回复，调度台据此统计参与数量。该功能在调度台发起组呼时触发，呼叫结束时退出。
术语 FOACSU 和 OACSU 分别代表什么中文含义？
FOACSU 代表手动摘机呼叫，OACSU 代表自动摘机呼叫。
在哪里可以查看 DMR 写频任务的执行情况？
在 “DMR -> 任务管理” 中查看写频任务执行情况。
What are the frequency bands supported by TETRA?
TETRA supports 350-470MHz and 806-870MHz.
What are the RX Sensitivity specifications under different conditions?
RX Sensitivity is 0.3uV/-117.5dBm at 12dB SINAD, typically 0.22uV/-120 dBm at 12dB SINAD, 0.4uV/-115 dBm at 20dB SINAD, and 0.3uV/-117.5 dBm at BER 5%.
How do Hytera HyTalk MC and Hytera HyTalk Pro solutions differ when integrated with the PDC760?

Hytera HyTalk MC is a PMR-characterized solution deployed over public networks, providing stable PTT communication, high-speed data applications, and multimedia services. Hytera HyTalk Pro provides high-quality audio and video services along with instant messaging.
Define ISSI and CPI based on their provided abbreviations.
ISSI stands for Individual Short Subscriber Identity, and CPI stands for Calling Party Identification.
ISSI、SNA、FSSN、Full Run和Short Run类型的号码属于什么数据类型？
整数类型。
RUN支持哪些业务，不支持哪些业务？
RUN仅支持TMO模式下半双工/全双工端到端呼叫及短信业务，不支持组呼及对应的短信业务。
在SDS Message及Status Message中，能否以FSSN方式发起组呼？
不能以FSSN方式发起组呼。
如果输入的组呼号码是终端的背景组，会发生什么？
不允许发起呼叫，将提示“无效号码”。背景组不允许以拨号方式发起呼叫。
当输入的组呼号码与默认组不一致时，默认组会改变吗？
不会改变。当输入的组号号码与默认组不一致时，默认组不随组呼呼叫的发起而改变。
受限组扫描功能是为了解决什么具体问题而增加的？
系统只能广播14个邻站，且自动优选基站只能携带6个，导致终端直接在高山站边缘开机时，无法自动切换到不受限的邻站。
在高山站边缘开机登记时，什么情况下终端需要通过新的扫描策略切换到未广播的邻站？
当系统广播的邻站或自动优选基站无法满足终端登记需求时，需要通过新的扫描策略切换到未广播的邻站。具体包括两种情况：一是系统广播的邻站最大14个，但终端可用的邻站不在这14个中；二是自动优选基站最大只能携带6个基站信息，且未携带终端可用邻站。
对于组上报受限的情况，终端除扫描系统广播的邻站外，还需要扫描哪些内容？
对于组上报受限，除扫描系统广播的邻站，还需要扫上次登记10条信道+段/短扫描列表。
当组受限后自动优选基站无可用基站时，终端需要执行怎样的扫描操作？
需要扫描邻站列表合集中的剩余邻站、上次登记10条信道+段/短扫描列表。
受限站列表的存储规格及其在扫描业务中的作用是什么？
受限站列表按组ID关系存储，最大可存储10个组ID，每个组ID可存储50条受限站信息（包含系统码、信道号）。其作用是：在扫描登记时查找待机组的受限站列表，若邻站信道在列表中则跳过；该列表同样适用于所有后台扫描业务（背景扫描含增强背景、回望扫描、Vote now扫描、超时扫描），均会跳过受限站列表中的信道。当组上报或组附着结果为不受限时，会将当前登记站相同系统码的基站从待机组的受限站中删除。
在受限组扫描中，如何处理满足条件的单站邻站？
若满足条件的邻站为单站，直接将该单站放到最后，在段/短扫描列表信道检测结束后再对单站发起登记。系统最大记录6个单站，并按场强排序，场强低的会被挤掉。
终端如何获取14bit系统码以进行自动优选基站处理？
终端根据LAI后4bit与当前站邻站列表获取到14bit系统码（无PAR）。
在自动优选可用基站流程中，终端如何处理受限站列表中的基站？
终端将获取到的14bit系统码与受限站列表中系统码对比，将14bit相同的系统码的基站从待机组的受限站中删除。
在终端扫描时，对于与邻站合集中相同的信道号，允许登记的条件是什么？
必须扫描信道系统码与邻站系统码相同（对比前14bit）才允许登记，否则作为干扰信道丢弃。非邻站信道无此判断，可以正常登记。
受限组扫描的优先级如何？如果在扫描停留间隔过程中被业务打断，应如何处理？
受限组扫描优先级低于语音和数据业务优先级，业务结束后才能执行扫描。若扫描停留间隔过程中被业务打断，业务结束后返回需接续上次扫描过程。
在混合模式下发起无信令呼叫应使用哪个 PTT 键？
应按住【副 PTT】键发起呼叫。
在对讲机模式下，如何通过智能旋钮切换信道以及退出该状态？
按下【智能旋钮】后旋转旋钮可以切换信道。如果 5 秒内未操作或在 5 秒内再次按下【智能旋钮】，将返回音量调节状态。
USB连接电脑后，若选择“不进行数据传输”模式，设备具备哪些功能限制？
在该模式下，设备仅与电脑连接，电脑无法读取数据，但可以为设备充电。
什么情况下对讲机会自动结束组呼或个呼？
当双方无人按【PTT】键讲话，且超过呼叫保持时间时，对讲机会结束组呼或个呼。
当对讲机的参考时钟设置为本地授时时，时间是如何同步的？是否可以手动设置？
对讲机开机后，从时钟芯片获取时间数据，同步更新显示时间。此时可以手动设置日期和时间。
在扫描停留时，如何暂时删除当前信道？
按【噪声信道删除】快捷键将该信道暂时删除。
对讲机实现自动优先打断后，哪些操作可以打断当前信道上正在进行的语音呼叫？
可使用对讲机报警、回呼、全呼或发送短消息来打断该语音呼叫。
如果需要覆盖 380MHz~430MHz 频段，应选择哪款天线？
应选择型号为 AN0405H18 的 9cm 天线。
What is the channel bandwidth and access method specified for the professional digital trunking communication system?
The system uses a 12.5 kHz TDMA channel.
Which layer of the air interface do the technical specifications cover for this system?
The technical specifications cover the call control layer of the air interface.
该系列标准是基于什么信道和技术的专用数字集群通信系统？
基于 12.5 kHz 信道的时分多址（TDMA）技术。
该系列标准包含哪些具体的技术规范名称？
包含总体技术规范、空中接口物理层及数据链路层技术规范、空中接口呼叫控制层技术规范、移动终端技术规范、安全技术规范以及系统互联技术规范。
本标准规定了基于12.5kHz信道的TDMA专用数字集群通信系统空中接口呼叫控制层的哪些内容？
本标准规定了地址码、协议数据单元格式、消息顺序和参数定义等内容。
该标准适用的频率范围是多少？
30 MHz ~ 1 GHz
该标准针对的信道带宽是多少？
12.5 kHz
该标准适用的多址接入技术是什么？
时分多址(TDMA)
用于唤醒休眠移动台的基本计时单位包含多少个时隙以及持续时间是多少？
包含16个时隙，持续时间为480ms。
专用控制信道（dedicated control channel）能否转换成业务信道或其他类型信道？
不能转换成业务信道或其他类型信道。
BER 的全称和中文含义是什么？
BER 的全称是 Bit Error Rate，中文含义是误码率。
CACH 代表什么信道？
CACH 代表公共广播信道 (Common Announcement Channel)。
CCL 的中文名称和英文全称分别是什么？
CCL 的中文名称是呼叫控制层，英文全称是 Call Control Layer。
What is the full form of CSBK?
CSBK stands for Control Signalling BlocK.
What does CSBKO represent?
CSBKO represents CSBK Opcode.
FEC 的全称和中文含义是什么？
FEC 的全称是 Forward Error Correction，中文含义是前向纠错。
FOACSU 的中文名称及其英文全称是什么？
FOACSU 的中文名称是手动摘机呼叫，英文全称是 Full Off Air Call Set-Up。
在通信术语中，MS 和 ms 代表什么？
MS 和 ms 代表移动台 (Mobile Station)。
OACSU 对应的中文技术术语是什么？
OACSU 对应的中文技术术语是自动摘机呼叫。
PDU 的英文全称和中文翻译分别是什么？
PDU 的英文全称是 Protocol Data Unit，中文翻译是协议数据单元。
RC 的全称和中文含义是什么？
RC 的全称是 Reverse Channel，中文含义是反向信道。
RSSI 代表什么指标？
RSSI 代表接收信号强度指示 (Received Signal Strength Indication)。
TS 和 ts 代表什么设备？
TS 和 ts 代表集群基站 (Trunking Station)。
TSC 的中文名称和英文全称分别是什么？
TSC 的中文名称是集群基站控制器，英文全称是 Trunking Station Controller。
UDT 代表什么含义？
通用数据传输 (Unified Data Transport)
空中接口协议栈模型分为哪三层？
空中接口协议栈模型分为物理层（层1）、数据链路层（层2）和呼叫控制层（层3）。
呼叫控制层支持哪些补充业务？
呼叫控制层支持紧急信令、预占优先和迟后进入等补充业务。
在常规中转模式使用“由基站建立时序”时，移动台如何唤醒基站？
需要由 MS 发送基站激活数据突发 (BS_Dwn_Act PDU) 来唤醒基站。
当基站在休眠状态下检测到移动台发送的同步字时，若色码不匹配或数据类型不是控制信令帧，基站应如何处理？
基站应保持休眠状态。
基站在休眠状态下检测到同步字后，进入挂起状态的条件及后续动作是什么？
条件是色码匹配且数据类型是控制信令帧。满足条件时，基站将启动移动台非激活定时器 (T_MSInactive)，并转换到挂起状态。
CCL_1 和 CCL_2 向数据链路层 (DLL) 发送什么原语后会转换到信道挂起状态？
CCL_1 和 CCL_2 将产生空闲帧 (Generate_Idles) 原语发送到数据链路层 (DLL)，随后转换到信道挂起 (Channel1_Hangtime、Channel2_Hangtime) 状态。
数据链路层发送 BOR 原语至 CCL_1 后，CCL_1 的状态如何变化？
CCL_1 将转换到“转发时隙 1”状态。
若时隙 2 处于“转发时隙”状态，CCL BS 将转换为何种状态，并执行哪些转发操作？
CCL BS 将转换到“转发两个时隙”（Repeating_Both_Slots）状态，在该状态下将转发移动台语音头（Voice_LC_Header），然后连续转发时隙 1 语音突发。
当 BS 开始转发时，对 CACH AT 信息单元有什么设置要求？
需要将 CACH AT 信息单元设置为繁忙。
图6展示的是基站处于哪种状态时的处理流程？
基站处于“转发时隙1”状态。
在图6所示的流程中，基站在时隙1接收到的是什么帧？
语音链路控制结束帧（Terminator_with_LC）。
数据链路层在发送 EOR 原语至 CCL_1 的同时，还会向 CCL BS 发射什么原语？
数据链路层会同时发射一个 EOR_Slot_1 原语至 CCL BS。
当接收到相关信号时，若时隙 2 分别处于“信道挂起”和“转发时隙”状态，CCL BS 将如何转换状态？
如果时隙 2 处于“信道挂起”(Channel2_Hangtime) 状态，CCL BS 转换到挂起状态；如果时隙 2 处于“转发时隙”(Repeating_Slot) 状态，CCL BS 转换到“转发时隙 2”(Repeating_Slot_2) 状态。
在信道挂起时间内，基站于时隙1收到CSBK后如何处理？
基站CCL_1发射一个TX_CSBK_Slot_1原语至数据链路层以转发CSBK，并保持在信道挂起状态，基站将转发接收到的CSBK。
移动台不活动定时器（T_MSIactive）超时后，基站执行哪些操作并进入什么状态？
CCL BS发送“关闭时隙”（Kill_Slot_Process）原语至CCL_1和CCL_2，并转换到“基站休眠”状态，此时基站将停止下行发射。
遵循信道避让接入规则时，若移动台收到不支持的信令且信道空闲，应如何响应？
直接发送NACK_Rsp PDU。
遵循信道避让接入规则时，若移动台收到不支持的信令但信道繁忙，后续处理流程是什么？
启动退避定时器（T_HoldOff），超时后重新尝试发送NACK_Rsp PDU。
组呼发起时遵循的信道接入规则有哪些类型？
组呼发起的信道接入规则包括：不让避、避让与自己色码相同的信道、避让有其他活动的信道（如数字常规或其他业务）。
组呼使用什么帧来承载控制信息以通知对方？
组呼利用语音链路控制头帧（Grp_V_Ch_Usr）承载必要的控制信息通知对方。
组呼如何支持迟后进入功能？
组呼通过将链路控制信息嵌入到语音突发中，使后来开机或进入通信范围的组内移动台可加入通话，从而支持迟后进入。
空值填充嵌入式消息被嵌入到哪个信道位置？
空值填充嵌入式消息将被嵌入到上行信道语音超帧“突发 F”中。
空值填充消息（Null）嵌入在哪些信道中？其链路控制码和突发个数是多少？
空值填充消息总是嵌入在上行语音超帧的 F 帧和不需要使用反向信道指令的下行信道中。其链路控制码为 NA，突发个数为 1。
在RMO模式下，移动台接收上层PTT请求时需要满足哪些同步条件？
与我的色码相同；与我的时隙相同。
图12展示了移动台对哪种原语的处理流程？
上层 PTT 请求(PTT_Request)原语。
呼叫状态包含哪几种类型？
呼叫状态包括：我的呼叫(My_Call)、不在呼叫中(Not_in_Call)、会话中(In_Session)、其他呼叫(Other_Call)。
呼叫控制层发送发射请求(TX_Request)原语后，会进入什么状态？
呼叫控制层发送发射请求(TX_Request)原语至数据链路层后，会转换成等待发射响应(Wait_for_TX_Response)状态。
在移动台数据链路层发送流程中，CCL 发送“BOTx”原语后状态会转换为什么？
状态会转换到 TX_Voice。
图20展示了移动台在何种场景下的处理流程？
图20展示了移动台在基站转发语音链路控制结束帧(Terminus_with_LC)期间接收到地址不匹配PDU的处理流程。
PATCS 和 OACSU 呼叫建立分别支持哪些信道接入规则？
PATCS 呼叫建立可以使用不避让、对自己色码避让和对所有避让三种信道接入规则；OACSU 建立方法只能使用对自己色码避让和对所有避让两种信道接入规则。
处于 In_Session 或 My_Call 状态的移动台应使用哪种信道接入规则？
处于 In_Session 或 My_Call 状态的移动台都应使用不避让信道接入规则。
在 OACSU 呼叫建立过程中，源移动台如何发起呼叫以及目标移动台如何响应？
源移动台应首先尝试检测目标移动台，通过发送语音单呼请求（UU_V_Req CSBK）建立呼叫。目标移动台接收到该请求后，自动回复语音单呼应答（UU_Ans_Rsp CSBK）。
如果源移动台在 OACSU 过程中收到“接受”应答，后续将采用何种方式建立呼叫？
如果收到的应答信息为“接受”，则源移动台采用不避让信道接入规则的 PATCS 方式建立呼叫。
呼叫开始时应发送哪种控制帧来通知对方？
应发送单呼语音链路控制帧（UU_V_Ch_Usr）承载必要的控制信息以通知对方。
单呼链路控制信息如何嵌入以支持迟后进入？
单呼链路控制信息嵌入到语音突发中，用以支持迟后进入。
在控制信令帧中，用于目的方检查的功能对应的值和数据内容分别是什么？
值为00112，数据内容为UU_V_Req。
当数据内容为UU_An s_Rsp时，其对应的数据类型、功能和值是什么？
数据类型为控制信令帧，功能为应答，值为00112。
全呼业务由用户发起后，发送过程的起始和结束分别是什么？该业务是否支持迟后进入？
全呼从发送语音链路控制头开始，用发送链路控制结束帧结束呼叫。本业务支持迟后进入。
在直通模式下，目标用户收到动态重组 DGNA_Req 信令后的处理流程是什么？
目标用户首先对发起方进行授权验证，验证成功后再与自己的 ID 或组呼列表中的 ID 相比对。如果 ID 匹配，则接受此次动态重组，并在组呼列表中增加新的临时组。
为什么发起方需要在动态重组的有效期内按照一定时间间隔发送建立信令？
为了使后开机的用户也能接收到动态重组的指令。
动态重组任务结束后，用户如何从组呼列表中删除该临时组？
有两种方式：一是动态重组发起方主动发送拆除指令，用户收到后自动删除；二是若未收到拆除信令，只要该组在 Timer_Inactive 时间内没有任何呼叫，被叫用户会自动认为主叫已取消重组并删除该组。
嵌入信令使用的CRC长度是多少比特？
5比特。
组呼链路控制PDU的哪些字节与通用完整链路控制帧格式一致？
字节0和字节1。
请列出 N(S)、IG、A、FMF 和 S 这些标识符对应的中文名称及位数。
N(S) 是发送序号（3 bits）；IG 是组呼或单呼标识（1 bit）；A 是响应请求标识（1 bit）；FMF 是消息完整标识（1 bit）；S 是重新同步标识（1 bit）。
空值填充消息（NULL_Msg）PDU 的字节 0 中，哪些比特与通用短链路控制帧结构一致？
字节 0 的 0～3 比特。
控制信令PDU的单元长度是多少比特？时隙1和时隙2的哈希地址长度各为多少比特？
控制信令PDU的单元长是96比特。时隙1和时隙2的哈希地址长度均为8比特。
时隙1和时隙2的哈希地址内容是什么？其HASH检验算法参考哪个标准的哪一部分？
时隙1和时隙2的哈希地址内容均为目的地址的哈希校验值。HASH检验算法见GB/T 34991—2017附录C中的C.3.6“8比特循环冗余校验的计算”。
基站呼出激活 (BS_Dwn_Act) CSBK PDU 的字节结构是如何定义的？
字节 0 和 1 与通用的完整 LC 格式一致，用 CSBK0 替代 FLOCO；字节 2 到 9 承载基站下行激活详细信息。
端到端单呼语音请求 (UU_V_Req) PDU 的字节 0 和 1 以及字节 2 到 9 分别承载什么内容？
字节 0 和 1 与通用的完整 LC 格式一致，用 CSBK0 替代 FLOCO；字节 2 到 9 承载端到端单呼语音请求详细信息。
在1比特的发送方类型标识(SRCT)信息单元中，值为0和1分别指示由哪类设备发起业务？
值为0表示基站发起，值为1表示终端发起。
TGI在基站业务分配中起什么作用？
TGI是基站在分配业务时临时分配给移动用户的组地址，用于包容呼叫业务、并呼业务等，业务结束后该临时组地址自动无效。
大于 $\mathrm{C} 00_{16}$ 的事件标签有什么作用？$\mathrm{ECA}_{16}$、$\mathrm{FFF}_{16}$ 和 0 分别代表什么含义？
大于 $\mathrm{C} 00_{16}$ 的事件标签用作网关标签，与服务及网关号码的低 12 比特相同。其中，$\mathrm{ECA}_{16}$ 表示基站地址标识，$\mathrm{FFF}_{16}$ 表示所有用户标识，0 表示无效。
什么是移动用户编号（MSN）？
移动用户编号（MSN）是指主叫用户为呼叫集群系统中的一个移动用户所需拨的号码。
缩写 AIEKI、MSDI 和 ESNI 分别对应哪些业务标识？
AIEKI 对应空口加密密钥业务标识，MSDI 对应无线双工业务标识，ESNI 对应设备编号 ESN 申请业务标识。
f_sp 代表什么，其数值是多少？
f_sp 代表系统的信道间隔，为 12.5 kHz。
基站对控制信道的数量有什么基本要求？
基站至少需要一个控制信道。
基站的控制信道可以分为哪两种类型？
可以是专用控制信道，也可以是复合控制信道。
在什么条件下可以使用控制信道上的 RC 帧实现辅助控制功能？
当空中接口使用双时隙 TDMA，且业务信道与控制信道在相同载频时。
使用控制信道上的 RC 帧实现辅助控制功能的主要目的是什么？
为了实现对业务信道的辅助控制，同时不影响控制信道的下行同步性能。
控制信道 RC 帧使用什么同步字？
数据帧同步字。
控制信道 RC 帧用于传输什么内容？
同载波另一个业务信道的反向信令。
Rest_Info 的有效净荷是多少比特，承载什么信令？
有效净荷为 56 比特，承载 C_RBCAST 信令。
在BS转信时，若使用下行时隙1和上行时隙2作为逻辑信道1，下行延后上行多少时间？
下行延后上行 60 ms。
在上行语音超帧中，第2至5语音帧的原同步字位置携带什么信令？
携带 P_EMSU 信令。
在分组数据复帧中，哪一帧携带同步字？
仅复帧的第一帧携带同步字。
分组数据复帧中使用的同步字二进制序列是什么？
下行分组信令帧包含哪些具体的帧类型？
下行分组信令帧包括 P_DAH0Y、P_DAL_DACKD、P_CLEAR 和 P_PROTECT。
下行分组信令帧采用的同步字二进制序列是什么？
上行分组数据帧每帧携带的同步字二进制序列是多少？
上行分组信令帧包含哪些组成部分，并应符合什么标准？
上行分组信令帧包括 P_DRAND 和 P_DACKU，应符合 GB/T 34991—2017 的要求。
语音编码加上信道编码后的速率是多少？
语音编码加上信道编码后的速率为 3.6 kbps。
语音业务信道支持哪些接入方式？
语音业务信道除进行“先听后发(LBT)协议”接入外，也可根据 CACH 的 TACT(AT=1)进行预留接入。
CACH中的时隙计数器CSC有多少比特？
CSC共9比特。
CSC自动加1的时间间隔是多少？
每发送120 ms，CSC自动加1。
什么是复帧？
120 ms（4个时隙）称为一个复帧。
分组数据协议能承载哪些类型的数据业务？
分组数据协议能承载多种数据业务，包括 IP 协议数据、短数据等。
在对齐模式下，移动台如何发起随机接入？
移动台在分组业务信道发起随机接入 P_DRAND。
在对齐模式的预留接入流程中，基站发送什么信令来预留时隙？
基站发送响应邀请上行数据信令 P_DAL_DACKD 预留时隙给移动台。
在对齐模式的预留接入流程中，移动台在哪里上传数据？
移动台在预留时隙上上传数据。
当信息单元 AT 的值为 12 时，表示什么状态？
上行时隙占用
信息单元 PI 的值为 1₂ 时，嵌入信令中携带的是什么类型的帧？
端到端加密的同步帧
二进制值 $0110_{2}$ 对应的帧类型是什么？
数据头帧
CSBK 码为 $110001_{2}$ 的 Broadcast 类型信令别名是什么，其功能说明为何？
别名为 TV_GRANT，功能说明为组呼语音信道分配。
CSBK 码 $111000_{2}$ 在作为 CSBK 帧和 MBC 后续帧时，分别对应什么 Broadcast 别名？
作为 CSBK 帧时对应 C_MOVE，作为 MBC 后续帧时对应 MV_AP。
在CSBK信令中，AT_VOTE、AT_REG和AT_ADJ分别代表什么广播功能？
在CSBK信令中，AT_VOTE代表判选通知广播，AT_REG代表重复登记广播，AT_ADJ代表广播邻近基站信息。
Unified Data Transport协议中，C_UDTHD和C_E2EEHD的作用分别是什么？
C_UDTHD是UDT数据头帧，C_E2EEHD用于承载数据加密控制信息。
在Unified Data Transport中，C_UDTHU和P_UDTHD分别对应什么帧类型及FLC0码？
C_UDTHU对应数据头帧（UDT 数据头帧），其FLC0码为011011_2；P_UDTHD对应数据头帧（UDT 数据头帧），其FLC0码为$011010_{2}$。
Random Access类型的信令别名、FLCO码和帧类型分别是什么？
Random Access类型的信令别名为P_RAND，FLCO码为0111112，帧类型为CSBK。
Voice LC Header中，组呼和单呼的起始信令与结束信令对应的别名及FLCO码有何异同？
组呼起始信令为P_VHU_GRPV，FLCO码0000002；单呼起始信令为P_VHU_INDV，FLCO码0000112。组呼结束信令为P_TMU_GRPV，FLCO码0000002；单呼结束信令为P_TMU_INDV，FLCO码0000112。起始和结束信令中，组呼与单呼的FLCO码不同，但各自对应的组呼或单呼类型的起始与结束FLCO码相同。
P_DAH0Y (0101002) 在 CSBK 中代表什么功能？
P_DAH0Y (0101002) 代表分组寻呼和释放。
P_DAL_DACKD (0100012) 在 CSBK 中的作用是什么？
P_DAL_DACKD (0100012) 用于响应数据和 ALOHA 控制。
P_DRAND 对应的二进制值和功能描述是什么？
P_DRAND 的二进制值为 010111₂，属于 CSBK 类型，功能是分组随机接入。
无确认的分组数据（Unconfirmed Data Transport）和有确认的分组数据（Confirmed Data Transport）分别对应哪个标识符及帧类型？
无确认的分组数据对应 P_UCDHU，有确认的分组数据对应 P_CDHU，两者均为数据头帧。
P_PD_E2EEHU 的作用和帧类型是什么？
P_PD_E2EEHU 是数据头帧，用于承载数据加密控制信息（EPDH）。
在两个时隙都是业务信道的载频上发送的 CACH 中，SLC 功能码为 $1010_{2}$ 表示什么状态？
单呼分组数据激活状态。
在两个时隙都是业务信道的载频上发送的 CACH 中，SLC 功能码为 $1100_{2}$ 和 $1101_{2}$ 分别代表什么？
$1100_{2}$ 代表紧急组呼语音激活状态，$1101_{2}$ 代表紧急单呼语音激活状态。
在两个时隙都是业务信道的载频上发送的 CACH 中，时隙 1 和时隙 2 的 HASH 地址各占多少位？它们的作用是什么？
