交通和流量远程信息处理（TTT）中DSRC传输设备的传输速率有哪些？
500 kbit/s 和 250 kbit/s。
智能交通通信系统（ITS）无线电设备的工作频段范围是多少？
5 855 MHz到5 925 MHz。
工作于5 GHz频段的智能交通通信系统的接入层规范属于哪类系统？
智能交通通信系统（ITS）。
What operational requirement is imposed on equipment to handle co-channel operations?
There is a requirement to deploy equipment that can sense its environment and avoid operating co-channel.
How is a sub-band defined within a band plan in the context of FDD and TDD operations?
A sub-band refers to a contiguous range of frequencies for FDD uplink, for FDD downlink, or for TDD operation, within a band plan.
What developments could make high-capacity broadband-wireless systems more competitive with wireline approaches in the longer term?
Developments include mesh capabilities to reduce deployment costs, higher spectral efficiency, low-cost commoditized base stations, and future spectrum allocations for mobile-broadband systems.
When is an operator forced to consider upgrading or expanding a base station site?
An operator is forced to consider upgrading or expanding a site only when "normal" subscribers are filling up a base station site and there is congestion.
What specific innovations allow TDMA to effectively compete with the capacity and data performance of other technologies?
Innovations like frequency hopping, the adaptive multi rate (AMR) vocoder for voice, and EDGE for data performance optimization.
Which multiple access technologies have been the focus of considerable discussion in the wireless industry regarding their relative benefits?
Time-division multiple access (TDMA), code-division multiple access (CDMA), and orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing/orthogonal frequency-division multiple access (OFDM/OFDMA).
Why do OFDM/OFDMA systems have an inherent advantage over TDMA or CDMA systems in larger bandwidth channels?
They transmit mutually orthogonal subchannels at a lower symbol rate, address the problem of intersymbol interference induced by multipath propagation, and greatly simplify channel equalization.
What are the strategic benefits of advancing HSPA for IMT-2000 systems given the modest advantages of OFDM/OFDMA over CDMA in 5 MHz channels?

Advancing HSPA is a logical and effective strategy for extending the life of operators' large deployments, reducing overall infrastructure investments, decreasing capital and operational expenditures, and allowing operators to offer competitive services.
What are the main components and functions of a wireless cellular network architecture?

Wireless cellular networks consist of radio access networks (RANs) connected to a Core. The RANs consist of base stations and their controller functions. The Core network provides Mobility Management, Authentication, Authorization, etc. functions and access to the Internet or other networks.
How do femtocells differ from Wi-Fi hot spots in terms of spectrum usage and backhaul connection?

Femtocells use cellular frequencies instead of Wi-Fi spectrum. They use a high-speed internet connection (DSL or cable) rather than the wireless network to convey a call from a handset to the carrier’s switching station.
What is Orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM)?

OFDM is an FDM modulation technique that divides a communications channel into a small number of equally spaced frequency bands, each of which carry a portion or sub-signal of the radio signal. These sub-signals are then transmitted simultaneously at different frequencies to the receiver.
In which mode of the IEEE 802.16 WirelessMAN Air Interface standard is OFDMA used?
OFDMA is used in the mobility mode.
What are the net usable throughput capabilities of base stations operating in unpaired spectrum for 5 MHz and 10 MHz bandwidths?
Base stations operating in unpaired spectrum provide 20 Mbit/s net usable throughput in 5 MHz and 40 Mbit/s throughput in 10 MHz.
Which factors contribute to the spectral efficiency of a wireless system?
Factors contributing to spectral efficiency include modulation formats, air interface overhead (signalling information other than user data), multiple access method, and usage model.
How is the spectral efficiency of 4.28 bit/s/Hz/cell calculated for the system with an effective frequency reuse pattern of 1/2?
It is calculated by dividing the product of 3 slots and 475 kbit/s per slot by 625 kHz and then by the 0.5 reuse factor.
What access capacity does each HC-SDMA base station provide when using 10 MHz of usable spectrum?
Each HC-SDMA base station provides 40 Mbit/s of access capacity.
What are the physical characteristics and connectivity options of the iBurst Access Bridge?
The iBurst Access Bridge looks similar to a traditional modem, has a connection to mains power, a small extending aerial, and ports allowing connectivity through either Ethernet or USB.
How many SDMA channels can be supported on each physical carrier in each cell by the iBurst system's spatial processing and interference management software?
The software supports up to 3 SDMA channels on each physical carrier in each cell.
What are the key performance characteristics of the eXtended Global Platform standard?
The eXtended Global Platform standard features high data rates for both uplink and downlink, as well as high efficiency of spectral utilization.
What is the main causal factor for realizing a micro-cell system?
The main causal factor is an autonomous decentralized control method for the channel assignment.
What functions does the air interface of "Enhanced PHS" include that were mostly absent from the original 1993 standard?
The air interface includes packet switching communication, multi-channel connection, various rate modulation (BPSK – 256-QAM), adaptive modulation, half-rate transmission, and multi-slot bundle.
What are the multiple access methods used by Enhanced PHS and Next-generation PHS (eXtended Global Platform)?
Enhanced PHS uses TDMA, while Next-generation PHS (eXtended Global Platform) uses OFDMA/TDMA.
What is the maximum data rate for Next-generation PHS (eXtended Global Platform) under the specified conditions?
The maximum data rate is 38 Mbit/s, based on 10 MHz bandwidth, downlink, and 256-QAM.
Under what condition is continuous assignment of more than 4 slots possible?
Continuous assignment of more than 4 slots is possible when an asymmetric frame structure is employed.
What is the sub-carrier spacing in the 'eXtended Global Platform' system and how does it compare to typical OFDM systems?
The sub-carrier spacing is 37.5 kHz, which is comparatively wider than typical OFDM systems.
Why is the eXtended Global Platform suitable for performing adaptive beam forming based on adaptive array antenna?

It is suitable because it inherits the symmetric TDD frame, which allows utilizing the reciprocity of a TDD channel to control signal amplitude and phase based on the channel state estimated from the portable station's received signal.
What mechanisms constitute link adaptation control and how are they managed?

Link adaptation control consists of transmit power control and selective modulation and coding scheme (MCS) control. A portable station sends its channel quality indicator (CQI) to the cell station, which then controls transmit power and MCS parameters for the next transmission based on adaptive algorithms.
How do cell stations manage frequency resources in the eXtended Global Platform?

Cell stations acquire and release frequency resources in an autonomous distributed manner, assigning the best channels for portable station link assignment requirements without needing detailed cell designing based on cell locations and frequency assignment.
How does the Handover (HO) function in eXtended Global Platform maintain voice communication during cell switching?

It realizes seamless radio link connection between portable station and cell station switching to other cell station, without interrupting voice communication. This is realized by multi-link to both originate and destination cell station from portable station, and by transferring the information to destination cell station network, such as IP session and user authentication information.
What are the key capabilities provided by the CDMA2000 EV-DO family of standards?

The CDMA2000 EV-DO family of standards provides full QoS and efficient support for a wide variety of packet data applications such as VoIP, video telephony, wireless gaming, push-over-cellular, broadcast/multicast.
How does the frame duration in 1xEV-DO Release 0 compare to that of IS-2000?
In 1xEV-DO Release 0, a frame is 26.66…ms, whereas in IS-2000, a frame is 20 ms.
What are the key enhancements of the uplink physical layer in cdma2000 1xEV-DO Revision A?
The key enhancements include Hybrid ARQ (H-ARQ) support, higher order modulation (QPSK and 8-PSK), a higher peak rate of 1.8 Mbit/s, and finer rate quantization.
How does the downlink MAC layer in cdma2000 1xEV-DO Revision A utilize Packet Division Multiple Access (PDMA)?
Using PDMA, the access network can transmit data to multiple users using the same physical layer packet, which improves physical layer packing efficiency and reduces transmission latency.
What mechanisms does the uplink MAC layer in cdma2000 1xEV-DO Revision A employ for interference control and QoS?

It employs contention-managed multi-flow QoS support, comprehensive network control of spectral efficiency and latency trade-off for each flow, and a more robust interference control mechanism that permits system operation at higher rise-over-thermal.
What are the key enhancements to the physical layer and MAC layer in the DO Revision A downlink?

The key enhancements include short-packets (128-bit, 256-bit, and 512-bit), higher peak data rates (3.1 Mbit/s) with finer rate quantization, one-to-many mapping of DRC index to transmission formats, packet division multiple access via multi-user packets, and seamless adaptive server selection.
What are the key enhancements to the physical uplink in DO Revision A?

The key enhancements to the physical uplink in DO Revision A are physical layer H-ARQ, higher data rates (peak data rate of 1.8 Mbit/s/1.25 MHz) with finer rate quantization, and comprehensive centralized control with minimal signaling overhead.
What are the fundamental concepts introduced in Multi-carrier EV-DO?

The fundamental concepts include channel aggregation via Multi-link Radio Link Protocol (ML-RLP), symmetric and asymmetric modes of operation, adaptive load balancing, flexible duplex carrier assignment, and terminal battery life improvements (talk time and standby time improvements).
What are the centralized uplink control mechanisms in 1xEV-DO Revision A?
The mechanisms include Explicit control Fast RA, Explicit TxT 2P control, and Peak rate Flow specific PER transmission interpretation.
What is the purpose of multi-link RLP in channel aggregation?
Multi-link RLP allows achieving higher peak data rates utilizing multiple carriers on the forward link using 1xEV-DO-Revision A channel cards.
Under what conditions is RLP required for a terminal?
RLP is required when a terminal is assigned carriers on channel cards that do not communicate with each other and operate an independent scheduler.
What are the three modes of operation supported by multi-carrier EV-DO?

Multi-carrier EV-DO supports symmetric multi-carrier operation (feedback multiplexing mode), basic asymmetric multi-carrier operation (basic feedback multiplexing mode), and enhanced asymmetric multi-carrier operation (enhanced feedback multiplexing mode).
How does asymmetric mode of operation reduce reverse link overhead?
Asymmetric mode of operation reduces reverse link overhead because the pilot channels for the additional reverse link carriers are not transmitted.
What distinguishes enhanced asymmetric multi-carrier mode from basic asymmetric multi-carrier mode regarding feedback channels?

In enhanced asymmetric multi-carrier mode, feedback channels for up to four forward CDMA channels are transmitted on a single reverse link using the same long code, whereas basic mode uses unique long codes for each feedback channel.
Why is static load balancing unable to achieve uniform loading across carriers on shorter time scales?
Static load balancing cannot achieve uniform loading on shorter time scales due to the variable nature of application flows and bursty data sources.
What mechanism allows an access terminal to achieve fine load balancing on the reverse link?
Fine load balancing on the reverse link is achieved by per packet carrier selection of the assigned carriers by the access terminal.
How does flexible duplex spacing differ from typical CDMA systems regarding channel assignment?

Typical CDMA systems assign forward and reverse CDMA channels with a fixed spacing, whereas flexible duplex spacing allows any reverse CDMA channel from a band class to be coupled with any forward CDMA channel from that band class or with a forward CDMA channel.
What are the key features and data rate capabilities of WCDMA 3GPP Release 5?

WCDMA 3GPP Release 5 introduced the high speed downlink shared channel (HSDPA), which reduces latency and provides downlink data rates of up to 14.4 Mbit/s. It also increases capacity compared to Release 99, thereby reducing the production cost per bit.
What enhancements were introduced in WCDMA 3GPP Release 6 and what data rates do they support?

Release 6 introduced a new uplink transport channel called enhanced uplink or HSUPA (high speed uplink packet access). This enhancement provides higher throughputs, reduced latency, increased capacity, and supports data rates of up to 5.8 Mbit/s.
What technologies does HSPA evolution (HSPA+) in 3GPP Release 7 support to boost performance?
HSPA evolution, introduced in 3GPP Release 7, supports MIMO, 64-QAM for the downlink, and 16-QAM for the uplink to further boost peak data rate and capacity.
What is the latency associated with HSPA+ in Release 7?
The latency for HSPA+ in Release 7 is 40 ms.
What are the peak downlink packet-data transmission rates for the IMT-2000 CDMA TDD specification across its different chip rate modes?
The peak data rates are 2.8 Mbit/s, 10.2 Mbit/s and 20.4 Mbit/s for the 1.28 Mchip/s, 3.84 Mchip/s and 7.68 Mchip/s modes respectively.
What peak data rates does the addition of 16-QAM modulation allow for the enhanced uplink in the IMT-2000 CDMA TDD specification?
It allows for peak data rates up to 2.2 Mbit/s, 9.2 Mbit/s and 17.7 Mbit/s for the 1.28 Mchip/s, 3.84 Mchip/s and 7.68 Mchip/s modes.
Which subframes and fields are always reserved for downlink transmission in Frame structure Type 2?
Subframes 0 and 5, as well as DwPTS, are always reserved for downlink transmission.
In Frame structure Type 2 with 10 ms switch-point periodicity, which subframes are reserved for uplink and downlink transmission respectively?
UpPTS and subframe 2 are reserved for uplink transmission, while subframes 7 to 9 are reserved for downlink transmission.
How do WCDMA/HSPA technologies utilize existing core network infrastructure for packet data?

WCDMA/HSPA technologies separate data packets at the base station controller and direct them through a PCU to a packet network. This reuse also extends to security, authentication, and other management elements of the core network.
What is the general philosophy of ultra mobile broadband (UMB) design?
The general philosophy is to provide significantly higher data rates while lowering the cost per bit of the system.
What are the main areas of performance improvements in UMB besides wider bandwidths and advanced multiple antenna techniques?

The other main areas of performance improvements include better spectral efficiency, lower latency, improved battery life, higher capacity, and enhanced user experience for delay sensitive applications such as VoIP.
What duplex modes and network configurations does the UMB unified system design support?
UMB supports full and half duplex FDD modes with scalable bandwidth and can operate in a mixed network with synchronous as well as asynchronous access points (APs).
Which coding and retransmission techniques are used in UMB to achieve high spectral efficiency?
Adaptive coding and modulation with turbo or LDPC codes and synchronous hybrid ARQ (H-ARQ) are used to achieve high spectral efficiency.
What advanced multi-antenna techniques are included in the UMB OFDMA forward link?
The UMB OFDMA forward link includes advanced multi-antenna techniques such as closed loop precoding, multi-input multi-output (MIMO), and space-division multiple access (SDMA).
How does UMB RL manage interference and improve edge data rates?

UMB RL manages interference through fast power control based on interference caused to neighbor sectors. It uses Fractional Frequency Reuse (FFR) to further improve edge data rates and handoff performance.
What are the characteristics of the selected interlace mode and semi-connected mode in UMB regarding power consumption and traffic suitability?

The selected interlace mode allows for sleep between transmissions, resulting in low power consumption in the active state, and is suited for low rate latency sensitive traffic such as VoIP. The semi-connected mode allows long sleep intervals between data bursts and is suited for latency tolerant traffic.
What are the fixed tone spacing and FFT size capabilities defined in UMB numerology?
Tone spacing is fixed to 9.6 kHz for all bandwidth allocations. Five different FFT sizes are defined to support bandwidth allocations in the range from 1.25 MHz to 20 MHz.
How does UMB achieve improved peak rates and trunking efficiency through multi-carrier operation?
UMB features multi-carrier operation that enables improved peak rates and trunking efficiency of a system with higher bandwidth by combining multiple physical carriers.
What information does the superframe preamble carry?
The superframe preamble carries acquisition pilots and primary overhead channels needed for initial system acquisition, time frequency synchronization, and AP configuration discovery.
How are Forward Link (FL) and Reverse Link (RL) frames organized into half-duplex interlaces in UMB?
Every even FL frame and every odd RL frame belong to one half-duplex interlace, while every odd FL frame and every even RL frame belong to the other half-duplex interlace.
What is the H-ARQ retransmission latency for both Forward Link and Reverse Link?
Both the Forward Link and Reverse Link feature H-ARQ retransmission latencies of approximately 7.3 ms.
Why are extended frames particularly useful on the Reverse Link (RL) in UMB?

Extended frames are useful on the RL because they allow for an increased packet size when the AT's spectral efficiency is limited by link budget constraints, thereby avoiding the MAC overhead penalty associated with very small packets.
What is the retransmission latency enabled by the optional 6 interlace Forward Link (FL) timeline in UMB?
The optional 6 interlace FL timeline allows for a retransmission latency of around 5.5 ms.
How does the Block Resource Channel (BRCH) provide frequency and interference diversity?

Each BRCH channel hops within a larger set of contiguous tones (subband), providing frequency and interference diversity across H-ARQ transmissions, and within an H-ARQ transmission for assignment sizes larger than one tile.
What role does the Forward Dedicated Pilot Channel (F-DPICH) play in supporting multi-antenna techniques in BRCH?

F-DPICH facilitates the implementation of multi-antenna techniques such as precoding and SDMA by applying spatial signaling, used for data transmission on every BRCH channel, to pilot modulation symbols, making it transparent to the AT.
What feedback does SCW MIMO operation require from the receiver?
SCW MIMO operation requires closed loop channel quality and rank feedback from the receiver.
Under what conditions is MCW MIMO more efficient than SCW MIMO?
MCW MIMO is more efficient at high C/I values and in the presence of spatially correlated channels.
What is the purpose of the channel quality backoff computed by an AT reporting a precoding index from a specific cluster?

The channel quality backoff accounts for the co-channel interference incurred when another AT is receiving a forward link transmission with a precoding matrix chosen from another cluster that is compatible with the former cluster.
How does the Access Point utilize the differential channel quality feedback received from an AT?
The Access Point uses the differential channel quality feedback to decide between single user (precoded) MIMO and SDMA, and to determine the corresponding data rates.
What capability does the concept of downloadable codebooks provide to UMB systems?

Downloadable codebooks allow UMB to support different antenna configurations and propagation conditions. The air interface supports mechanisms to identify existing codebooks and enables the AT to acquire new ones as needed.
What is statistical multiplexing used for in the context of contention-based channels?
Statistical multiplexing is used for contention-based channels such as access, FL/RL handoff indications, and RL bandwidth requests.
How does an AT initiate a handoff request to an AP in its Active Set?
An AT initiates a handoff request by sending FL and/or RL handoff requests in the next available CDMA control segment, which typically repeats every ~7.3 ms.
When is a handoff considered completed in this mechanism?
The handoff is completed when the AT receives the resource assignment from the target AP via the FL shared control channel.
How do ATs make Reverse Link (RL) handoff decisions using UMB mechanisms?

ATs make RL handoff decisions by using F-PQICH reports, which contain reverse channel quality measurements reported back by APs via the pilot quality indication channel transmitted as part of the FL control segment.
What are the two complementary mechanisms of interference management in UMB?
Regular and fast interference management.
Why is fast interference management necessary in broadband networks despite the theoretical stability of averaged RL interference?

In practice, broadband networks may experience dominant interference from just a few users and high variability due to bursty traffic such as web browsing, gaming, and instant messaging. In these scenarios, user experience is mainly determined by packet latency, making it important to ensure a high burst rate while maintaining control on other sector interference and facilitating interference avoidance between adjacent APs.
How does the FOSI indication mechanism control interference in UMB?

The AP sends a fast other sector (FOSI) indication for every RL frame and every RL sub-zone. When an AT receives a FOSI indication from an AP in its Active Set corresponding to a transmitted subband/frame pair, it reduces its transmit p.s.d. by a certain amount. If no FOSI is observed in response to the AT’s transmission, the AT increases its transmit p.s.d.
What are the timing and reporting requirements for transmit p.s.d. updates in the UMB closed loop operation?

The transmit p.s.d. is updated at every instance of the AT’s transmission, which occurs every 7.3 ms for every scheduled interlace. Any change in the transmit p.s.d. level is reported to the serving AP as part of the in-band (MAC) header.
What determines the initial transmit p.s.d. setting in the UMB open loop projection scheme?
The initial p.s.d. is based on the RF distance to the closest non-serving AP versus the serving AP. This approach aims to start with a conservative setting of the initial p.s.d. level.
What is the primary tradeoff associated with traditional sector-based fractional frequency reuse?
While it improves channel C/I and link reliability at the cell edge, it comes with the cost of bandwidth reduction, which is not necessarily a good capacity tradeoff.
What is a beacon pilot in UMB and what information does it carry?

A beacon pilot is a low-rate sequence of tones that carries AP identity as well as frequency (carrier) index. It facilitates inter-frequency handoff by enabling detection of AP signal strength on different carriers without re-tuning receive chains.
What is the supported bandwidth range for UMB?
UMB supports bandwidths from 1.25 to 20 MHz.
What components of the IEEE WirelessMAN and ETSI HiperMAN standards are included in their harmonized interoperability specifications?
The harmonized interoperability specifications include specifications for the OFDM and OFDMA physical layers as well as the entire MAC layer, including security.
How does the inclusion of profiles differ between IEEE 802.16 and ETSI HiperMAN standards?
IEEE 802.16 profiles are included in the main standards document, while HiperMAN profiles are included in a separate document.
What standard is WiMAX technology based on?
WiMAX technology is based on the IEEE 802.16 Air Interface standard.
How does OFDM signaling facilitate smart antenna operations in WiMAX systems?
OFDM signaling converts a frequency selective fading wideband channel into multiple flat fading narrow-band subcarriers, allowing smart antenna operations to be performed on vector flat subcarriers.
Which modulation orders are supported in both uplink and downlink for WiMAX?
QPSK, 16-QAM, and 64-QAM modulation orders are supported in both uplink and downlink.
What is the maximum handover delay achieved by the optimized hard handover supported in the WiMAX standard?
The optimized hard handover achieves a handover delay of less than 50 ms.
What mechanism provides optimal scheduling of space, frequency, and time resources for simultaneous control and data allocations?
Sub-channelization and MAP-based signaling schemes provide this mechanism for optimal scheduling on a frame-by-frame basis.
What channel bandwidth range do current WiMAX profiles support?
Current WiMAX profiles support several channel bandwidths ranging from 3.5 MHz to 20 MHz.
How is scalability achieved in the described system while keeping subcarrier frequency spacing fixed?
Scalability is achieved by adjusting the FFT size to the channel bandwidth.
Which subcarrier allocation modes and frame structures are supported by the IEEE 802.16 OFDMA PHY?
The supported modes include partially used sub-channelization (PUSC), fully used sub-channelization (FUSC), and advance modulation and coding (AMC), also known as adjacent multi-carrier.
What are the advantages of Time-division duplex (TDD) regarding spectral efficiency and channel monitoring?

TDD provides the ability for adaptation to varied DL to UL ratios for improved spectral efficiency in contiguous spectrum blocks with data-oriented traffic. It also assures channel reciprocity for more accurate monitoring of propagation path quality.
Which duplexing modes are supported by the standard for spectrum assignments consisting of paired channels?
FDD and H-FDD profiles are supported to fit spectrum assignments consisting of paired channels.
What are the three major functional groups defined in the mobile WiMAX system architecture?

The three major functional groups are: 1. Mobile station (MS), which represents a WiMAX-enabled user device; 2. Access Service Network (ASN), which terminates the WiMAX radio link and provides the radio access network (RAN); and 3. Connectivity Service Network (CSN), which represents an IP core network based on IETF standardized protocols for functions such as mobility, AAA, address management, policy management, and naming service.
Which channel spacings do the existing HiperMAN profiles target?
The existing HiperMAN profiles target 1.75 MHz, 3.5 MHz, and 7 MHz channel spacing.
What are the supported system channel bandwidths for OFDMA TDD WMAN in TDD mode?
5 MHz, 10 MHz, and 7 MHz.
Which modulation schemes are supported for uplink in OFDMA TDD WMAN TDD mode?
QPSK and 16-QAM.
What general guidelines are provided for managing base station-to-base station and mobile-station to mobile-station interference scenarios?
General guidelines are given in terms of requirements for guard bands, band-pass filters, and geographical separation.
What are the two fundamental types of interference depicted in Figure 33?

The two fundamental types of interference are transmitter interference, where receivers cannot discriminate between the required signal and unwanted emissions from front-end non-linearities or an adjacent channel transmitter, and receiver interference, where the selectivity properties of the broadband receiver receive signals in the adjacent transmit channel.
What are the approaches to reduce interference between broadband base stations using FDD and TDD while serving the same geographic area?
The approaches are additional filtering in both receivers and transmitters, and/or guard bands, or restricted channels.
What enables base stations and terminal devices to scale across a band and support spectrum efficiency?
The inherent filter characteristics and the combination of different filters enable base stations and terminal devices to scale across a band, thereby supporting spectrum efficiency.
How does the implementation of FDD filters differ from TDD filters in terms of design characteristics?

FDD filter implementation is based on a fixed filter design with band pass characteristics for the base station receive sub-band and the terminal receive sub-band. In contrast, TDD filter implementation is often fixed for the specific band or sub-band used.
How do filters facilitate coexistence between FDD and TDD access schemes?

Filters facilitate coexistence by suppressing unexpected interference where FDD and TDD access schemes are separated in frequency and base stations and terminals are used according to harmonized sub-band partitioning.
What type of interference affects the upper part of the FDD DL block in an international context, and what is the specific signal path involved?
The upper part of the FDD DL block is subject to co-channel interference cross borders, involving the signal path from base station FDD Tx to base station TDD Rx.
What is the overall conclusion of ITU-R studies regarding base station to base station interference with a 10 MHz guardband?

Even with a 10 MHz frequency separation between the edge of the transmit band and the edge of the receive band, base station to base station interference will be excessive unless additional measures are taken.
By how much do the additional filters need to improve selectivity and reduce adjacent channel leakage of base stations?
The filters need to improve selectivity and reduce adjacent channel leakage of base stations by the order of 50 dB.
What additional measures may be required for interfering base stations with less than 100 m separation distance, even if additional filters are applied?

Specific site engineering may be required. Special care is needed in cases of tower sharing and/or the presence of nearby reflective objects, such as large buildings. In some configurations where tower sharing is impractical due to interference, more antenna towers may be needed.
What synchronization requirements must adjacent base stations meet in unpaired operation to avoid interference?

The uplink and downlink sub-frames must be time-aligned, meaning frames start at the same time. The two systems should be frame-synchronized to a common source, having the same frame length and the same uplink to downlink ratio, with a common break point between the uplink and downlink.
How does co-channel interference occur across geographical borders between different TDD and FDD allocations?

Interference results from co-channel operations under different TDD and FDD allocations on either side of a geographical border. A base station on one side transmits on a channel that is being used simultaneously for receiving by a base station on the other side.
Why can interference between base stations be excessive even at very large distances in a co-channel case?
Interference can be excessive even at very large distances because base station antennas are generally placed at a height of 30 m or more, and filtering is not an option in a co-channel case.
What width of corridor is needed on each side of the border for co-channel scenarios if mitigation methods like reducing transmitted power are not introduced?
A corridor of approximately 15-35 km would be needed on each side of the border.
Under what condition will interference result between base stations operating TDD and FDD modes?
Interference will result if base stations are operating TDD and FDD modes according to different band plans at geographical borders.
What is the order of magnitude for the normal needed separation distances to minimize interference between base stations with different band plans?
The normal needed separation distances may be of the order of 75 km.
Why is interference between terminal devices using a TDD scheme difficult to manage between operators without synchronization?
For terminal device to terminal device, using a TDD scheme, the interference cannot be efficiently managed between operators without synchronization and identical uplink/downlink phasing.
What activity factor results from the assumption that an interferer transmits 2.5 ms per 20 ms period?
An activity factor of 12.5%.
How does a mobile VLAN enable an RLAN terminal to use its home network environment while at a remote network?

The MAC frame from the mobile RLAN terminal is encapsulated into an IP packet by the server at the remote network and transferred to the home network (MAC over IP). The server at the home network then de-encapsulates the IP packet back to the original MAC frame.
What are the four functions needed for mobile VLAN techniques?
The four functions are address resolution, terminal authentication, location registration for recognition of disconnection, and MAC frame encapsulation/de-encapsulation.
How does the CS recognize terminal disconnection?
The CS has a timer, and if reception of MAC frames from the mobile terminal stops for a certain period, it recognizes this as disconnection.
如何发起手动摘机呼叫？
长按呼叫键发起个呼，被叫方会显示呼叫信息。
如何开启“音量同步调节”功能并操作音量？
开启“音量同步调节”开关后，旋转【智能】旋钮可以同步调节所有音量。
使用【智能】旋钮选择信道或联系人时，若5秒内无操作或再次按下旋钮会发生什么？
如果 5 秒内未操作或在 5 秒内再次按下【智能】旋钮，返回音量调节状态。
在数字集群模式下，使用“联系人/信道上调”和“联系人/信道下调”键分别有什么作用？
在数字集群模式下，“联系人/信道上调”按照递增顺序切换组群中的组呼/个呼联系人；“联系人/信道下调”按照递减顺序切换组群中的组呼/个呼联系人。
如何在对讲机上查看专网号码和频率范围等信息？
点击“对讲设置”，选择“对讲机信息”，可以查看对讲机的专网号码、频率范围等信息。
什么是包容呼叫，其适用场景和限制是什么？
包容呼叫是集群模式下对讲机在通话保持过程中，邀请新的组呼联系人加入该通话的功能。它与普通组呼类似，拥有相同的抢话权和拆线功能，但目前仅支持普通组呼。
超时禁发功能的作用机制及默认设置是怎样的？
超时禁发是指在对讲机进行个呼、组呼、全呼或模拟呼叫时，若按住【PTT】键持续时间超过预设单次发射时间（默认为 60 秒），对讲机将自动终止发射并发出警告音。松开【PTT】键可停止警告音，需在预设时间后再次按住才能发射。此功能默认开启，旨在防止通信双方过久占用信道资源。
对讲机进行基站登记时的控制信道扫描分为哪两种类型，分别适用于什么情况？
分为固定扫描和灵活扫描。当对讲机频谱资源的收发频率间隔为固定值时，采用固定控制信道扫描；当对讲机频率无规律时，采用灵活控制信道扫描。
在使用对讲机发射时，为减少射频能量辐射影响，对讲机与身体应保持的最小距离是多少？
发射时对讲机与身体的距离至少保持在 2.5 厘米以上。
How can the TETRA radios PT590 and PT890Ex be managed through Smart MDM?
Smart MDM allows reading and programming the PT590 and PT890Ex TETRA radios through WLAN, and upgrading them through template.
What batch operations can Smart MDM perform on groups and contacts for a TETRA radio?
Smart MDM allows you to export groups and contacts from or import them to the TETRA radio in batches.
How do you adjust the volume and select the channel on the device?
Rotate to adjust the volume. Press and then rotate to select the channel.
What is the correct procedure for inserting Nano SIM and Micro SD cards?

Open the card slot cover, insert the Nano SIM cards into the corresponding slots, and optionally insert the Micro SD cards with metal contacts facing down. Finally, put the card slot cover back in place.
What does the "Priority interrupt" programmable key function do?
It allows you to interrupt the ongoing call, call hang, and remote monitor on the current channel to release it. Then you can initiate a new call or a new data service on that channel.
What is the function of the Roam feature?
The Roam feature allows the radio to automatically select a base station (BS) with a strong signal, which ensures seamless communication across sites or networks.
What is the full name for the abbreviation PDT?
Police Digital Trunking
G2.0产品集群模式下的RoIP互联方案软件需求描述文档的主旨是什么？
本文档的主旨是为G2.0产品集群模式下的RoIP互联方案提供软件需求描述，帮助软件开发人员及测试人员了解相关功能需求，指导以上人员进行集群RoIP功能的开发测试工作，使该功能更好的满足用户需求。
集群RoIP方案基于哪两个系统的对接？
集群的RoIP方案基于系统侧窄带系统和MPTT系统双系统之间的系统对接。
海能达POC系统对接海能达350兆数字集群系统后实现了什么功能？
实现了公网手机与公安集群对讲机间的互联互通。
NB后台扫描到可登记基站后，后续的网络选择流程是怎样的？
NB将网络质量通知到网络判选模块，由网络判选模块决定使用哪个网络。
双模终端登记在NB系统发起组呼，通话过程中因NB信号变差切换到RoIP时，该组呼的状态如何？
该组呼会被结束。
在NB支持但RoIP未支持的情况下，NB是否仍能正常接收？
NB仍然可以正常接收。
当前的组呼联系人限制是由哪个组件实现的？
由MPTT SDK实现。
由于存在ROIP业务附着和MMS业务附着不同步的问题，UE将如何处理附着状态及收发限制？
将在UE进行分别指示两种业务的附着状态，根据附着状态进行收发限制。
当NB登记切换到RoIP登记时，扫描组附着和NB侧去附着状态如何变化？
扫描组附着不变，NB侧不进行去附着。
扫描组变化后，NB侧和MMS侧如何向系统侧更新附着信息？
NB侧和MMS侧同时向系统侧进行扫描组附着的更新。
针对RoIP业务附着和MMS业务附着不同步的问题，系统采取什么措施进行收发限制？
将在UE进行分别指示两种业务的附着状态，根据附着状态进行收发限制。
AP在按压PTT发起呼叫时如何根据组附着结果选择呼叫类型？
AP根据宽带和窄带组附着的结果，在按压PTT发起呼叫时根据附着状态自动选择一路发起呼叫（语音或视频）。
PUC同步更新重组情况时存在什么风险？
可能存在窄带系统和PoC系统动态组成员信息不同的风险。
用户选择专网联系人或组呼联系人发送消息时，短消息长度是多少？终端如何确定承载网络？
短消息长度为46字节。终端自动根据自动选网结果选择承载网络。
专网个呼长消息和组呼长消息的最大长度限制分别是多少？
专网个呼长消息最长440字符，组呼长消息最长500字符。
RoIP在集群下需要支持什么防重复策略？
RoIP需要支持集群下针对存储转发的防重复策略。
警报鸣笛的执行顺序及等待回呼期间的处理规则是什么？
警报鸣笛顺序为：发送Alarm、等待回呼（Wait Back Call Time）、鸣笛。在等待回呼时间内，如果收到回呼，需等呼叫结束后再启动鸣笛过程。
全双工视频单呼包含哪些流？在窄带系统不支持全双工语音单呼的情况下，呼叫中如何处理视频单呼？
全双工视频单呼包含视频流和音频流。由于窄带系统不支持全双工语音单呼，在呼叫中不对视频单呼降级，不分音频流到窄带系统。
同源视频组呼中音频流和视频流分别使用什么编码？
音频流使用NVOC和AMBE编码，视频流使用AMR编码。
当同源视频组呼中存在NB成员时，PoC系统如何处理语音流？
PoC系统会将语音流发送给NB系统，纯NB终端能够收到该视频组呼中的音频流。
在集群系统中，MS代表什么设备？
MS（Mobile Station）指集群系统中的终端设备。
TS在集群系统缩略语中指的是哪类设备？
TS（Trunked Station）指集群系统中的系统设备。
TSCC的全称及其中文含义是什么？
TSCC的全称是Trunked Station Control Channel，中文含义为集群基站控制信道。
在集群呼叫业务中，成员需要满足什么条件才能按下 PTT 发起呼叫？
唯有各成员处于呼叫保持时间内，需要讲话的一方才可按下 PTT 发起呼叫。
在组呼或个呼通话的接收状态下，用户如何触发抢话功能？终端后续会执行哪些初始操作？
用户需长按 PTT 键触发。终端首先判别是否具备抢话权限，若具备则显示申请话权界面并发起抢话权请求，随后启动抢话定时器，保存业务相关参数并切换到控制信道。
终端切换到控制信道后，发送抢话业务申请信令遵循什么规则？何时回到业务信道？
发送信令遵循基本的 C_RAND 发送规则。终端需等待系统应答后，才回到业务信道。
在 T_Delay_PTT 定时器运行期间，非抢话终端能否向系统发送发话权申请信令？
不能。在定时器时间内，这些终端不能向系统发话权申请信令。
系统检测到终端发送语音头帧（P_VHU）后，后续的业务处理和信令流程如何执行？
系统继续原来的业务处理。本业务结束后的信令流程、处理逻辑与原组呼/个呼呼叫一致。
在组呼通话中，终端触发PTT后如何判别并发起抢话权请求？
终端首先判别是否具备抢话权限。若具备，则显示申请话权界面，并发起抢话权请求。
在什么情况下，系统会忽略抢话申请并保留原话权？
当发起抢话的终端发送请求后回到业务信道，系统收到请求并判断不允许抢夺话权时，会忽略该申请，原话权保留。这通常发生在抢话终端的优先级低于被抢终端的优先级时。
若被打断终端在系统收到抢话信令后仍未停止发射语音，会导致什么结果？
系统在本次抢话业务中不会下发授权信令，导致无线终端抢话失败。
在组呼或个呼呼叫过程中，高优先级终端抢话低优先级终端话权需要满足哪些条件？
系统与终端都支持抢话功能，且终端使能抢话业务。
进入组呼发射语言界面时，LED和Alert的状态分别是什么？
LED红灯常亮，发语音前响发射允许提示音。
在组呼或个呼过程中，高优先级终端如何获取低优先级终端的话权？
高优先级抢话终端可以抢占低优先级终端的话权。
终端成功返回业务信道并获取授权需要满足哪些状态条件？
终端需接收到系统回复，收到系统的授权，且此时抢话定时器未超时。
哪些呼叫类型不支持抢话业务？
广播呼叫与全呼不支持抢话业务，同样按正常流程进行。
T_Delay_PTT 定时器的作用、触发条件及可见性限制是什么？
T_Delay_PTT 定时器用来限制不能触发 PTT 的时间。在系统下发抢话终端授权后，非抢话终端收到 ENPTTONEMS 后启动该定时器。该参数仅在标准模式下可见。
当终端未检测到Hytera私有信令时，对私有上行信令的处理策略是什么？
未检测到该私有信令时，禁止发送私有上行信令。
Hytera 私有信令包含哪些具体类型？
Hytera 私有信令包括：空口加密 Aloha、私有多控 Aloha 信令和 C Bcast (AT SYSINFO，MFID=HFID)。
系统如何识别是否为 Hytera 系统？
系统通过空口加密 Aloha、私有多控 Aloha 信令和 C Bcast (AT SYSINFO，MFID=HFID) 这些私有信令来识别是否为 Hytera 系统。
异形系统标记信令的特征是什么？
异形系统标记信令为 C Bcast (AT SYSINFO，MFID 不是 SFID/PFID/HFID)。
越区切换时，若无法判断新基站是否为 Hytera 系统，终端如何处理？
终端按上一个登记站判断结果处理。
在Hytera模式下，组附着结束后对扫描组列表（SGL）申请的处理方式是什么？
组附着结束后不发送SGL申请（分组数据或状态码22），组业务响应按未附着处理。
终端判断为非Hytera系统时，如何处理自动优选基站功能及相关后台扫描流程？
终端不发送24号状态消息，将“自动优选基站”功能视为关闭处理，其他后台扫描如背景、回望、受限组扫描的流程按照自动优选基站功能未开启的流程进行。
DMR 的全称和中文含义是什么？
DMR 的全称是 Digital Mobile Radio，中文含义是数字移动对讲机。
TETRA 系统的中文名称是什么？
TETRA 系统的中文名称是陆地集群无线电系统。
该终端支持哪些集群服务和定位技术？
集群服务包括组呼、广播呼叫、动态重组、分组数据、鉴权、空口加密和端到端加密。定位技术支持卫星系统定位、基站定位和WLAN定位，可满足户外、室内、地下等环境的定位需求。
该系统在通信安全和数据存储安全方面采取了哪些措施？
通信安全方面提供鉴权、端到端加密、空口加密及二次开发加密技术。数据存储安全方面采用全磁盘加密、密钥和License加密。
How should an administrator select the radio type when adding keys for DMR and PDT radios?
For a DMR radio, choose DMR. For a PDT radio, choose PDT.
What is the minimum number of channels required in a scan list to enable scanning?
A scan list must have two or more channels before scanning can be enabled.
在主屏点亮的情况下，如何选择联系人或信道？
按下并旋转旋钮，可以选择联系人或信道。
What are the two types of NB mode and how do they differ in communication method?

The two types are Conventional mode and Trunking mode. In Conventional mode, the radio communicates with one or more other radios directly on the fixed channel frequency or through repeaters. In Trunking mode, the radio communicates on the channel frequency allocated by the trunking system.
How should Nano SIM cards and Micro SD cards be inserted into the PTC680?

Open the card slot cover and insert the Nano SIM cards into the corresponding slots. Optionally, insert the Micro SD cards into the corresponding slots with the metal contacts facing down, then put the card slot cover back in place.
PTT 的全称和中文含义是什么？
PTT 的全称是 Push To Talk，中文含义是按下讲话。
当数据格式为 16 bit 且别名长度大于 13 个字符时，发送到空口的别名如何处理？
按左到右截取 10 个有效字符，再加上 “...”，共 13 个字符发送到空口。
别名 LC 头的优先级特性及其在信令冲突时的表现是什么？
别名 LC 头的优先级为最低，可被其他信令抢占。例如，上行的别名 LC 头可能会在系统侧被非参与站越区需发送的 P_EMSU_Reselect 替换。
原有的 LC 头主要支持哪些功能？
原有的 LC 头作为迟后广播、越区切换 (集群)、语音加密等功能使用。
终端本地缓存空口别名信息的数量限制及超出后的处理原则是什么？
终端最多保存十个空口别名信息，超出时采用先进先出覆盖原则。
当 Alias Display Priority 设置为 Air Alias (1) 时，若空口未携带别名，系统会如何显示？
系统会显示联系人别名。
为确保PTC680符合职业或受控环境中的辐射限制要求，发送时间有何限制？
发送时间不得超过额定因数的 50%（最高 50%的时间发射）。
PTC680对讲机在哪些状态下不会产生射频能量辐射？
接收（收听）和待机时均不会产生射频能量辐射。
在集群模式下，指示灯橙色快闪和橙色常亮分别代表什么含义？
橙色快闪表示正在建立 HOOK 呼叫（被叫方显示）；橙色常亮表示通话过程中，此时可以按住【PTT】键讲话。
集群模式下的半双工个呼和全双工个呼有什么区别，如何切换？
半双工个呼通话期间双方无法同时讲话，全双工个呼通话期间双方可以同时讲话。可通过点击“设置 > 专网设置 > 默认呼叫建立方式”进行切换。
网内全呼、网外全呼以及集群模式下的全呼联系人号码分别是多少？
网内全呼联系人号码为 16777215；网外全呼联系人号码为 10231638316777215；集群模式下全呼联系人号码为 16777215。
对讲机支持哪几种参考时钟模式，各自的时间同步机制是什么？
对讲机支持本地授时、宽带授时和卫星授时三种参考时钟模式。本地授时从时钟芯片获取时间数据并同步更新；宽带授时在宽带系统注册成功并获取广播时间数据后自动同步；卫星授时通过定位系统获取卫星时间数据后自动同步。
直通模式下对讲机支持哪几种工作方式？若选择中继、网关或中继和网关方式，还需进行什么操作？
直通模式下支持的工作方式有：终端到终端、中继、网关、中继和网关。如果选择的工作方式为中继、网关或中继和网关，需开启自动选择设备或手动添加设备。
在集群模式下，PSTN 网关和 PABX 网关的默认地址分别是多少？
PSTN 网关地址默认为 16777184，PABX 网关地址默认为 16777186。
集群模式下的固定小区有什么作用及注册机制是怎样的？
固定小区是将文件夹关联到指定小区，一个小区允许关联多个文件夹，以确保参与呼叫的对讲机能快速注册到指定小区并充分利用相同区域内的信道资源。若配置了固定小区应用，切换文件夹时，对讲机会注册到与该文件夹关联的小区。
在集群模式下，对讲机配置了 GSDM 功能后，在信号较弱且无可用小区时能执行哪些操作？
可以接收组呼、发起或接收紧急呼叫、发送或接收紧急状态消息等。
集群模式下组呼探测是如何统计参与组呼的对讲机数量的？
调度台发起组呼的同时（呼叫建立成功后），向参与组呼的对讲机发送指定的状态消息。对讲机收到状态消息后，自动回复指定的状态消息。调度台根据收到的状态消息统计参与组呼的对讲机数量。
什么是声控功能，以及如何开启或关闭它？
声控是语音可直接触发发射的功能，当麦克风检测到语音音量达到发射条件时自动发射，无须按住【PTT】键。若配置了该功能，可通过点击或快捷开关选择“专网设置 > 声控模式”，或按【声控】快捷键来开启或关闭。
集群模式和直通模式下的紧急报警模式有哪些区别？
集群模式下，紧急报警模式分为紧急模式、紧急静默模式和紧急保护模式；而直通模式下，只有紧急模式和紧急保护模式。
在紧急轮询过程中，发起方如何抢占话语权？抢占后会发生什么？
发起方在接听状态时按住【PTT】键即可抢占话语权。抢占话语权后，紧急轮询结束。
What devices can be connected to the Smart MDM Lite system and what is the maximum capacity for TETRA PT3x units?

The Smart MDM Lite can connect multi-mode radios, broadband radios, and TETRA PT3x units via programming cable. The system supports one multi-mode radio or broadband radio and up to six TETRA PT3x units.
How do Conventional mode and Trunking mode differ in terms of communication channels?
In Conventional mode, the radio communicates directly on a fixed channel frequency or through repeaters. In Trunking mode, it communicates on the channel frequency allocated by the trunking system.
What is the difference between Hytera HyTalk MC and Hytera HyTalk Pro solutions when integrated with the PTC760?

Hytera HyTalk MC is a PMR-characterized talk solution deployed over public networks, providing stable PTT communication, high-speed data applications, and multimedia services. Hytera HyTalk Pro provides high-quality audio and video services along with instant messaging.
PDT系统内DNS传输层采用的协议和端口号是什么？
在PDT系统内，DNS的传输层采用UDP协议，端口号为53。
短二进制NMEA和长二进制NMEA分别采用多少比特的空口数据？
短二进制NMEA采用80比特长度空口数据，长二进制NMEA采用160比特空口数据。
交换中心之间通过发送OPTIONS心跳请求检测链路状态，判定链路断开的条件是什么？
发送端系统在连续发送5次心跳请求后没有收到200响应，应认为链路断开。
在发送删除用户拜访数据请求后，应向 H_ MSC 回复什么响应？
应回复 200 响应。
在MSC之间的单呼会话流程中，MSC1和MSC2分别代表什么？
MSC1表示主叫用户当前拜访的交换中心，域名为m1；MSC2表示被叫用户当前拜访的交换中心，域名为m2。
MSC2发送180响应的目的是什么？
MSC2可发送180振铃临时响应以指示正在响铃。
PTT 授权流程和会话释放流程包含几个部分？
3 个部分。
在 PTT 组呼中，哪个交换中心具有 PTT 授权的决策权？
只有 GH_MSC（当前组呼的归属交换中心）才具有 PTT 授权的决策权。
P_ MSC 发送 200 表明了什么？
表明已经收到 GH_ MSC
在PTT授权申请场景中，发送606拒绝请求的条件是什么？如果只收到VOICE，是否需要发送606？
在PTT授权申请中，发送606以拒绝其请求。如果只收到VOICE，则不需要发送606。
当GH_MSC接受O_MSC的抢话请求时，会回复什么响应？如果只收到VOICE，是否需要发送该响应？
GH_MSC接受O_MSC的抢话请求时，回复200响应表示允许。如果只收到VOICE，则不需要发送200。
在MSC越区切换的通告型流程中，A_MSC、B_MSC和B’_MSC分别代表什么含义？
A_MSC表示移动台漫游前拜访的交换中心；B_MSC表示移动台第一次漫游后拜访的交换中心；B’_MSC表示移动台第二次及以后漫游拜访的交换中心。
AP_MSC在MSC越区切换流程中指代哪个交换中心？
AP_MSC表示移动台通话对方拜访的交换中心。
组呼越区切换分为哪两种流程？
组呼越区切换分为通告型越区切换流程和非通告型越区切换流程。
在组呼越区切换的假定条件中，O_ MSC、GH_ MSC、PB_ MSC 和 PB’_ MSC 分别代表什么及其域名是什么？
O_ MSC 表示主叫用户拜访的交换中心，域名为 m1；GH_ MSC 表示组呼控制器，域名为 m2；PB_ MSC 表示移动台漫游前拜访的交换中心，域名为 m3；PB’_ MSC 表示移动台漫游后拜访的交换中心，域名为 m4。
消息 2 到消息 3 在越区切换流程中对应什么操作？
消息 2~ 消息 3 为获取越区切换号流程，同 A_ MSC~B_ MSC 的越区切换流程。
P_MSC 接受呼入的会话请求时，应发送的最终响应是什么？
P_MSC 接受呼入的会话请求，应发送最终响应 200。
在空口响应携带卫星定位数据后，应向哪个网元发送卫星定位数据？
应向移动台的归属交换中心 H_MSC 发送卫星定位数据。
在向 H_MSC 发送卫星定位数据时，body 部分应如何处理空口二进制格式的卫星定位数据？
body 部分应拷贝空口二进制格式的卫星定位数据。
How do you switch the work mode to DMR trunking or MPT trunking?
Tap the Radio Settings app, go to Basic settings > Work mode, and then tap Conventional, DMR trunking, or MPT trunking.
How are advanced features enabled for DMR radios in Smart MDM?
The user needs to apply for a license for advanced features and then enable them by importing the license.
在集群环境下，如何配置倒放触发报警时发送指定的状态码？
当倒放触发报警时，若紧急报警配置开启了紧急状态消息，则可在触发报警流程时发送指定的倒放状态码。
在什么条件下，触发倒放报警时会发送指定的倒放状态码？
当倒放触发报警时，若紧急报警配置开启了紧急状态消息，则可在触发报警流程时改为发送指定的倒放状态码。具体条件为：PTC产品系列启用“紧急状态消息”；PDC产品系列“报警模式”为“紧急警报”或“警报呼叫”。
当倒放触发报警时，在什么条件下可以发送指定的倒放状态码？
若紧急报警配置开启了紧急状态消息（PTC系列：启用“紧急状态消息”； PDC系列：“报警模式”为“紧急警报”或“警报呼叫”），则可在触发报警流程时发送指定的倒放状态码。

“PTT通话授权（DMR）”的定义、作用或说明是什么？

PNC550 的 信道间隔 是什么？
25kHz
PNC550 的 Channel Spacing 是什么？
VM550 的 Channel spacing 是什么？
25 kHz/20 kHz/12.5 kHz
在PDC680中，网元“基站、蓝牙设备等”的功能是什么？
提供 MAC 地址，由终端上传给 PPS 服务器，PPS 服务器将 MAC 地址换算为位置信息。
“AIE”的全称是什么？
Air Interface Encryption
“DMR”的全称是什么？
Digital Mobile Radio
“ISSI”的全称是什么？
Individual Short Subscriber Identity
“PDT”的全称是什么？
Police Digital Trunking
“TETRA”的全称是什么？
Terrestrial Trunked Radio
“PTT”的全称是什么？
Push-To-Talk
在PTC760中，“优先打断”功能的用途是什么？
打断当前信道上正在进行的语音呼叫、呼叫保持时间和远程监听，使信道空闲，以便进行新的呼叫或数据业务。
在PTC760中，“预设信道”功能的用途是什么？
跳转到预设信道。 预设信道需写频配置，可以是任意区域的一个信道。
在PTC760中，“扫描”功能的用途是什么？
开启或关闭扫描功能。
在PTC760中，“噪声信道删除”功能的用途是什么？
扫描过程中，临时删除不必要的噪声信道，待下次检测时将不检测该信道。
在MDM Pro中，报警模式“警报呼叫”表示什么？
发送紧急报警码，并可以通过按【PTT】键与对方进行通话。
在Smart MDM中，网元“基站、蓝牙设备等”的功能是什么？
提供 MAC 地址，由终端上传给 PPS 服务器，PPS 服务器将 MAC 地址换算为位置信息。
在Smart MDM相关资料中，“国家码”的说明是什么？
TETRA协议为每个国家分配的唯一号码。
在Smart MDM相关资料中，“频率列表”的说明是什么？
当前TETRA网络的频率列表。
在PT310相关资料中，“窄带 TETRA 终端”的说明是什么？
在Smart MDM相关资料中，“RadioID(数字集群)”的说明是什么？
PDT集群下的对讲机ID。
在Smart MDM相关资料中，“RadioID(模拟集群)”的说明是什么？
MPT集群模式下的对讲机ID。
在PT580H Plus相关资料中，“SDM功能”的说明是什么？
指基于SDS业务预留的空口资源，允许在基站计划的时间表中接收SDS的应答消息，并且保证无空口冲突（即同步概念）。该方法通过系统指定空闲时隙，提高终端的上行接入效率，并且可以避免与其他终端信令发送碰撞。
在Smart MDM相关资料中，“预占呼叫”的说明是什么？
开启本功能后，终端可以发起预占呼叫。预占呼叫是具有最高优先级的普通语音呼叫（除紧急呼叫以外的所有呼叫，包括个呼、组呼、广播呼叫等。）
在Smart MDM相关资料中，“SCK”的说明是什么？
用于为 TETRA 终端添加静态空口加密密钥。
在Smart MDM相关资料中，“AIE”的说明是什么？
用于为 DMR/PDT 终端添加常规空口加密密钥。
在Smart MDM相关资料中，“倒放为整机功能，且满足所有工作模式”的说明是什么？
常规、集群、TMO、DMO、MPT。
“基站全呼”功能开启后可以呼叫哪些用户？
可对终端所在基站下的所有有效用户发起全呼。
“本地全呼”功能开启后可以呼叫哪些用户？
可对终端所处区域内所有基站中的有效用户发起全呼。
“地域全呼”功能开启后可以呼叫哪些用户？
可对终端所在的单个集群系统中所有有效用户发起全呼。
“全网全呼”功能开启后可以呼叫哪些用户？
可对全网（可能包括多个集群系统）所有有效用户发起全呼。
什么是预占呼叫？
预占呼叫是具有最高优先级的普通语音呼叫，紧急呼叫除外。
呼叫优先级在系统无空闲业务信道时有什么作用？
系统优先响应优先级高的语音业务，为其提供业务信道。
DMO模式下呼叫优先级由低到高如何排列？
普通优先级、高优先级、预占优先级。
TMO模式下“当前扫描列表”用于设置什么？
用于设置当前扫描列表的别名。
组呼优先级中哪些等级不具有预占功能？
优先级1-11不具有预占功能。
“广播呼叫优先”开启后有什么作用？
终端将优先接入其他终端或调度台发起的广播组呼，使广播呼叫接入更及时。
“手动切换优先”功能的目标是什么？
让终端可手动切换并优先登记指定基站，只有该基站失锁时才按扫描策略选择其他邻站。
终端锁定在手动指定基站后还会执行背景扫描、回望扫描和越区切换吗？
不会。终端锁定后不再执行这些扫描策略。
手动切换优先与背景扫描、回望扫描、越区切换相比哪个优先级更高？
手动切换优先功能优先级更高。
手动切换优先与自动优选基站相比哪个优先级更高？
手动切换优先功能优先级更高。
“信道信息”菜单可以查看哪些当前信道信息？
可查看基站别名、基站编号、系统码、RSSI、信道号、收发频率和时隙。
固定控制信道计划下可以选择哪些扫描模式？
短扫描、全面扫描和段扫描。
控制信道计划为灵活控制信道时，扫描模式菜单如何显示？
扫描模式菜单隐藏。
PTC760的DMO模式如何通信？
仅支持单工，通过固定信道频率或中继器与一个或多个对讲机直接通信。
PTC760的TMO模式如何通信？
支持双工或单工，通过集群系统分配的信道频率与一个或多个对讲机通信。
PTC760中的组呼是什么？
私网中一个用户向组内所有其他成员发起的呼叫。
PTC760接收到组呼后需要操作才能收听吗？
不需要，可以直接收听。
PTC760如何响应收到的组呼？
按住PTT键，或在屏幕上按住圆形按钮，然后对着麦克风讲话。
PTC760中的个呼是什么？
私网中一个用户向另一个用户发起的呼叫。
PTC760中的电话呼叫是什么？
公网中一个用户向另一个用户发起的呼叫。
PTC760如何结束个呼？
按电源/结束呼叫键。
PTC760如何结束电话呼叫？
点击屏幕上的结束按钮或按电源/结束呼叫键。

25 kHz、20 kHz 和 12.5 kHz。
